7.title: Platform extension model (Phase B)
7.intent: How third parties extend pinion: heavy tier = native Rust (source crate now, abi_stable dylib later); light tier = existing JSON-RPC/AI channel; binary + WASM/script deferred evidence-first
rationale_bullets: Rust has no stable ABI; engine-tier extension (render/physics/ECS) needs native shared memory
WASM Component Model is shared-nothing: cannot cheaply pass wgpu::Device or vertex buffers across
Unreal/Unity extend the core in native C++; scripting (Blueprint/C#) is reserved for gameplay only
abi_stable/stabby give stable-ABI trait-object dylibs: binary native plugins without full recompile
Light tier already exists: JSON-RPC headless + AI introspection = sandboxed language-agnostic path
Native baseline keeps the public API rich native traits: no serialization-boundary reshape needed
caveats_bullets: 0 LOC this round: a decision-recording process round; baseline 4a is already the de-facto state
Standing constraint: keep plugin-seam traits abi_stable-wrappable (no leaked generics/lifetimes)
Defer trigger: first real second-party extension consumer promotes 4b/light-tier to a build round
Corrects the SEED 'make-or-break early spec round' framing: native baseline removes API-reshape risk
Not a §2 invariant: a Phase B direction, revisable when evidence (an actual plugin author) appears

alternatives_rejected.reason: shared-nothing boundary unfit for per-frame engine data
too slow for hot paths; AI-RPC fills the soft niche

alternatives_rejected.alternative: Hand-rolled C-ABI seam: same family as native (4c)
alternatives_rejected.reason: just the binary-shipping mechanism
no external plugin authors today = premature

428.decision_summary: Round 46.3.4 — §5.16 ai-introspect-demo winit suspend/resume RenderState enum — mobile/Wayland forward-compat: 두 Option field (window / renderer) 의 implicit-sync 패턴을 explicit RenderState { Active, Suspended } enum 으로 승격, R46.3 self-audit Concern #5 same-session 상환
changes_bullets: examples/ai-introspect-demo/src/main.rs: 신규 enum RenderState { Active { window: Arc<Window>, renderer: DemoRenderer }, Suspended(Option<Arc<Window>>) } 도입. Linebender Vello 0.6 canonical pattern (Xilem reference impl) 그대로 따름

App struct: window: Option<Arc<Window>> + renderer: Option<DemoRenderer> 두 field 제거 → state: RenderState 단일 field. App::new() 가 Suspended(None) 으로 시작. 두 Option 의 implicit 상관관계 제거 — typed ADT 가 illegal states unrepresentable
resumed() 해들러: 이메 Active 는 no-op. Suspended(cached) 에서 cached window 재사용 (있으면) 또는 create_window. DemoRenderer::new 호출 실패 시 cached window 는 보존 (다음 resumed 재시도 가능) — std::mem::replace 로 안전한 state 전환
suspended() 해들러 신규 — Active 에서 window 만 따서 Suspended(Some(window)) 으로 전환. renderer 는 드롭 (wgpu Surface 해제, OS 가 reclaim 가능). 데스크탑 platform 은 suspended 미호출 (no-op forward-compat slot)
request_redraw() / render() / Resized handler 가 RenderState pattern matching 으로 재작성. Active 에서만 renderer 접근, 나머지 모두 no-op. clippy::single_match_else 해소 을 위해 if let 패턴 사용 (조기 return 있는 None branch)

R1004.decision_summary: Model-View at-scale campaign slice 5: a search-and-jump cursor over a large data set. A GridFilter query drives a match CURSOR (next/prev/jump, wrapping) that scrolls each match into view via reveal_row, while EVERY row stays visible -- the inverse of the filter axis, which removes non-matching rows. Search is the THIRD consumer of the R997 GridFilter match vocabulary (the filter axis removes, R998 coloring tints, search navigates), so a query reads in the same wire form. New pinion-core widgets::row_search: a pure RowSearchState cursor + match set memoized via the shared OrderMemo, and a RowSearchExternal RPC adapter that optionally reveals the match through an attached ScrollState (the nav_select_key reveal idiom -- reveal is the adapter's job, the state stays pure). New hello-grid-search reference example (highlights matches via the R998 row_style hook, no new paint substrate) + RPC demo.
changes_bullets: New pinion-core widgets::row_search: search_matches free fn (the source rows a
GridFilter accepts, ascending) + reactive RowSearchState (query + cursor Signals;
the match set memoized on the query via the shared OrderMemo, sound because the
source is materialized + immutable). match_count / current_index / current_row /
match_at; set_query lands the cursor on the first match; next_match / prev_match
wrap; jump_to is range-guarded (an out-of-range jump is a no-op, never a panic).
RowSearchExternal: the AI-first RPC adapter (query / match_count / current /
current_row / count / match.<i> query; set_query / next / prev / jump / clear
invoke; query intervene). source_at_value (R780) projects match.<i>. Optionally
carries a ScrollState (with_reveal) so every cursor move scrolls the match into
view via reveal_row -- the nav_select_key reveal idiom, keeping the state pure
(reveal is the adapter's job, as VirtualSelectExternal leaves it to the glue).
Search REUSES the R997 GridFilter::matches (the THIRD consumer of the match
vocab: the filter axis removes, R998 coloring tints, search navigates), the
grid_filter_str / grid_filter_from_str wire + clamped_to_col_count (a phantom-
column query collapses to no search), reveal_row (5th consumer), and OrderMemo
(7th) -- no new windowing or match substrate, only the row-match cursor.
New hello-grid-search example (10k-row grid, seed query Name~Delta; the current
match paints a strong strip + the other matches a wash via the R998
VirtualTableData.row_style hook, no new paint substrate; ALL rows stay visible,
unlike the filter axis) + tools/demos/r1004_grid_search.py.
verification_bullets: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --features pinion-runtime/vello (-D pedantic): 0 warnings.
cargo test --workspace -j2: 7134 passed / 0 failed (row_search 13 ok: free-fn match
set, cursor land/walk/wrap, range-guarded jump, numeric-facet reuse, query/intervene/
invoke round-trips, match.<i> Null pad, phantom-column clamp, with_reveal scrolls;
hello-grid-search 4 ok: seed-query membership, next walk keeps all rows, numeric reuse).
tools/demos/r1004_grid_search.py: PASS deterministic x3 (seed query + first-match land,
match.<i> oracle sweep + Null pad, next/prev/jump with wrap, jump scrolls the match into
the painted window, window keeps non-match neighbours [search != filter], numeric >=
reuse, clear/restore/intervene, phantom-column clamp, out-of-range jump no-op).
mnemosyne validate-workspace: T1 reject=0 (entries 988 -> 989, no new orphan).
carry_forward_bullets: Search runs over the un-reordered source, so a match's source index == its view
position; composing search with a sort/filter proxy that permutes rows needs a
source->view map before reveal_row (additive, when a consumer combines them).
RowSearchState materializes its own cells (like GridSortState); a consumer
carrying BOTH a sort proxy and a search over the same data duplicates the
materialized source -- sharing it needs a common source type, the Model trait
the project deliberately omits (lift on a real dual consumer, not before).
Keyboard search nav (Enter / F3 next, Shift+F3 prev) is a binding-glue follow-up;
the example is RPC-driven (the AI-first path), mirroring hello-grid-row-style.

R1005.decision_summary: Model-View at-scale campaign slice 1b: paged out-of-memory streaming -- a virtualized log whose row count grows at runtime AND whose rows are paged behind an LRU-bounded async ResourceCache, so memory stays flat while the stream is unbounded (a GB DLT log / Wireshark capture / oversized tail -f). Two genuine substrate additions: (1) ResourceCache::invalidate -- drop a cached page so the next ensure re-fetches it, the streaming-tail-page primitive (the partial last page is stale once the stream appends onto it; re-keying by version would leak a dead carrier per append, so in-place invalidation re-fetches the same key); (2) at_bottom + follow_tail lifted from hello-streaming-log (R996) into the virtual_list windowing substrate -- R996 left them local as the 1st streaming consumer and explicitly named this paged view as the 2nd consumer that lifts them. New hello-paged-stream reference example + RPC demo. An adversarial pre-commit review (2 reviewers + self-grep) was folded in before committing (cargo-doc break + stale module doc + follow_tail viewport asymmetry + a tautological LRU test).
changes_bullets: pinion-core reactive/resource_cache.rs: new ResourceCache::invalidate(&K) -- pop
a key so the next ensure re-fetches it (the streaming-tail-page primitive). The
partial last page of a growable paged source is stale once the stream appends
onto it; re-keying by an embedded version would leak a dead carrier per append,
so in-place invalidation re-fetches the SAME key. Fetch-safe exactly as LRU
eviction (an in-flight fetch completes onto the detached carrier; the re-ensure
starts fresh). Returns () (the producer invalidates the tail unconditionally;
idempotent on an absent key). 2 unit tests (refetch-with-grown-data, absent no-op).
pinion-core widgets/virtual_list.rs: lifted at_bottom(offset,max) + follow_tail
(scroll,count,pitch,viewport_h,was_following) from hello-streaming-log (R996, the
1st streaming consumer) into the windowing substrate, on the 2nd consumer R996
named -- the paged view. follow_tail grows the scroll bound to the new extent +
pins to the new bottom when following, using ONE viewport_h for both the bound
and the pin (scroll_to to the computed bottom, not reveal_row which re-reads
measured_viewport -- they diverge before first layout). 2 unit tests.
hello-streaming-log: re-pointed to the lifted at_bottom/follow_tail (local copies
removed, apply_emit delegates); module doc rewritten to record the lift (was
"stays local / will lift / 1b not demonstrated", all falsified this round).
New hello-paged-stream example: StreamSource holds only the reactive count (rows
synthesized per page = out-of-memory); fetch_page(page,count) yields the partial
tail page; PageCache = ResourceCache::with_capacity(4); the prefetch Effect
subscribes to offset + count; apply_emit invalidates the partial tail page (guard
old_count % PAGE_SIZE != 0) BEFORE bumping the count, so the count-change re-run
re-fetches it, then follow_tail. 7 unit tests (the LRU one witnesses real
eviction via !contains(&0), not just len <= cap).
tools/demos/r1005_paged_stream.py: the AI-first E2E (tail-page re-fetch witness =
row 50 joins the re-fetched page 0; out-of-memory residency <= 4/4 streaming to
700+ rows; eviction skeleton-then-data; pause/resume follow).

invalidate refetch-with-grown-data + absent no-op; virtual_list 47 ok incl
at_bottom + follow_tail; hello-paged-stream 7 ok incl real eviction witness
[!cache.contains(&0)]; hello-streaming-log 8 ok after the re-point).
cargo doc -p hello-streaming-log -p hello-paged-stream --no-deps: 0 (no unresolved
links; the commit hooks run clippy not doc, so a dangling [content_height] link
left by the lift was caught + fixed in the pre-commit adversarial review).
tools/demos/r1005_paged_stream.py: PASS deterministic x3; r996_streaming_log.py
regression PASS x2 (the at_bottom/follow_tail lift preserved behaviour).
Adversarial pre-commit session review (2 reviewers + self-grep) cleared, folded
into this commit: HIGH cargo-doc break + MED stale module doc (lift falsified
"stays local / will lift / 1b not demonstrated") + LOW follow_tail viewport_h
asymmetry (pin now uses one viewport_h, not reveal_row's re-read) + MED
tautological LRU test (added the !contains(&0) eviction witness) + LOW at_bottom
vs RPC ScrollEdges cross-note.
mnemosyne validate-workspace: T1 reject=0 (entries 990 -> 991, no new orphan).
carry_forward_bullets: The measured-viewport fallback (measured_h == 0 ? CONST : measured) stays
duplicated in each example's apply_emit -- the const is consumer-specific (each
example's own VIEWPORT_H), so there is no clean substrate home; follow_tail takes
the resolved viewport_h. Acceptable example-local duplication, not a missed lift.
A page boundary crossed by an Emit re-fetches the (now-full) old tail page only
when it was partial (old_count % PAGE_SIZE != 0); brand-new pages are absent so
ensure fetches them fresh -- no invalidate needed for a page that did not change.
ResourceCache::invalidate (cache: pop a key) is distinct from Resource::invalidate
(a single resource: bump the generation token); same verb, different level. The
cache form is required because ensure guards on presence, so a generation bump
alone would not re-fetch through ensure.

R1006.decision_summary: R1006 §5.23 §5.22 §6.3 §5.16: view-time viewport-size seam (window resize -> producer reflow) — SPEC SEED only (design ratified + 3 source-verified review corrections, no code this round); sprag PR-6 intake, view-time provider family sibling of R999 RepaintSink / R1003 MonospaceMetrics
changes_bullets: SPEC SEED only — no code landed this round; records the requirement + ratified design + 3 source-verified review corrections for a future implementing round (design-only shape like spec-phase round-14/15, not R999's land-the-core shape). sprag PR-6 intake.

Requirement: a binding must read the current layout viewport (w,h) at view/effect-time (no run() fork, no paint-time hook) to re-derive (cols,rows)=viewport/cell and drive a producer reflow (PTY TIOCSWINSZ) — the winsize SSOT producer-adoption leg.

Gap confirmed in source: Frame carries only dt (frame.rs:21-25); boot seeds repaint_sink + monospace_metrics but no viewport provider (core_shell.rs:466,472); compute_paint_scene_internal holds (w,h) but routes it to compute_layout only, never to the view (substrate.rs:2328,2402-2407); ImmediatePainter::viewport_size() is paint-time only (scene.rs:2702).

Ratified design: Signal<(u32,u32)> (a changing value — NOT a Frame field, NOT a capability trait like repaint/metrics) seeded on root Owner; Owner::provide_viewport_size + use_viewport_size() (tracked get, strict Owner::current().expect mirror of use_repaint_sink); CoreShell.viewport_signal seeded (0,0) at boot; set_viewport_size(w,h) set INSIDE root_owner.run, called every primary-window paint, DEFAULT_WINDOW-gated.

Coordinate space = layout viewport (the exact (w,h) compute_layout consumes), defined by reference to layout's input so it auto-follows when HiDPI logical-px layout lands; HiDPI is a separate prior gap, out of scope here.

5 sprag-side workarounds rejected as smell: view-side resize (purity break); empty ImmediateMode probe (PR-3 WindowsDirty-hijack isomorph); winit inner_size/scale recompute (SSOT dup); renderer.resize intercept (layer break); post-layout rect in read_state (nonexistent).
verification_bullets: Blocker (B) verified in source: Effect::rerun runs the body via run_with_node (effect.rs:152) which pushes only CURRENT_OWNER, not CURRENT_OWNER_HANDLE (owner.rs:1326-1329) — so Owner::current() inside a synchronous effect re-run resolves to the lexical owner at set()-time; set_viewport_size MUST set inside root_owner.run or the first resize panics on use_viewport_size()'s expect. The frame_signal driver survives only because its body is signal.get() (never calls Owner::current).

CORRECTION to acceptance R6.2: the inert-during-snapshot/AT protection is NOT the is_simulating() gate. SimulationGuard::enter is called ONLY in pinion-rpc simulate.rs:165/208 + dry_run.rs:98; plain scene/snapshot and AT paint run with is_simulating()=false. Their protection is Signal equality-skip (signal.rs:83), which holds ONLY because introspection paints at the live viewport. An off-live-size snapshot capability would resize the real PTY (a world-perturbation) unless it enters a SimulationGuard. The contract must state BOTH mechanisms.

CORRECTION (boot eager-run): the reflow Effect runs eagerly once at create_extra_externals with the (0,0) boot seed, so grid_dims floors to 1x1 and a spurious 1x1 PTY resize fires at boot unless the consumer guards on the (0,0)=viewport-unknown sentinel. The contract must mandate (0,0) => skip explicitly (the eager (0,0)!=boot-dims case does not satisfy plain unchanged-skip).

CORRECTION (multi-window): a single root-seeded shared signal makes a secondary window's view read the PRIMARY's size (view fns all run on root, substrate.rs:2365-2405; the DEFAULT_WINDOW gate stops secondary writes clobbering primary but gives secondary no value of its own). Single-window sprag-gui unaffected; per-window signal is a deferred carry (RepaintScope precedent).

Acceptance mechanisms confirmed in source: equality-skip = no notify on same value (signal.rs:83-85); is_simulating() gate in Effect::mark_dirty (effect.rs:178) suppresses dry_run/simulate; provider first-write-wins via Owner::cache (owner.rs:1113-1161). Crate home pinion-core/src/reactive/viewport.rs mirrors repaint.rs/font_metrics.rs.
Design-only round: no cargo build/test run (no code). impact_refs cite only existing sections (5.23/5.22/6.3/5.16) so no new cross-ref orphan is introduced; validate-workspace confirmed post-append.
carry_forward_bullets: Implementing round (future): pinion-core/src/reactive/viewport.rs (ViewportSizeHolder(Signal<(u32,u32)>) + VIEWPORT_SIZE_KEY + use_viewport_size); Owner::provide_viewport_size + viewport_size_signal; CoreShell viewport_signal field + (0,0) boot seed + set_viewport_size(w,h) inside root_owner.run called on primary-window paint in compute_paint_scene_internal (DEFAULT_WINDOW-gated).

Contract MUST encode the 3 corrections: (1) snapshot/AT protected by equality-skip + introspection-paints-live-size, NOT is_simulating — off-live-size snapshot must SimulationGuard; (2) consumer reflow Effect skips on the (0,0) sentinel to avoid a boot 1x1 resize; (3) primary-only — secondary window reads primary's size until a per-window signal lands.

Open questions: API shape Signal<(u32,u32)> standalone vs future Frame.scale_factor surface-geometry bundle (recommend standalone — YAGNI until HiDPI); per-window viewport signal (deferred); HiDPI logical-px layout is a separate prior gap the seam auto-follows.

Separate nit (out of scope): WindowEvent::Resized arm (app.rs:1681-1690) calls renderer.resize only, no request_redraw — reflow may lag to next input where the compositor does not auto-send RedrawRequested; fold a request_redraw into the implementing round.

sprag-side companion (out of scope, sprag repo): TerminalSession::resize &mut->&self (emulator as dimensions SSOT); pure grid_dims(viewport,cell) helper; reflow Effect in create_extra_externals reading use_viewport_size().

SimulationGuard::enter is called ONLY in pinion-rpc simulate.rs:165/208 + dry_run.rs:98; plain scene/snapshot and AT paint run with is_simulating()=false. Their protection is Signal equality-skip (signal.rs:83), which holds ONLY because introspection paints at the live viewport. An off-live-size snapshot capability would resize the real PTY (a world-perturbation) unless it enters a SimulationGuard. The contract must state BOTH mechanisms.

CORRECTION (boot eager-run): the reflow Effect runs eagerly once at create_extra_externals with the (0,0) boot seed, so grid_dims floors to 1x1 and a spurious 1x1 PTY resize fires at boot unless the consumer guards on the (0,0)=viewport-unknown sentinel. The contract must mandate (0,0) => skip explicitly (the eager (0,0)!=boot-dims case does not satisfy plain unchanged-skip).

CORRECTION (multi-window): a single root-seeded shared signal makes a secondary window's view read the PRIMARY's size (view fns all run on root, substrate.rs:2365-2405; the DEFAULT_WINDOW gate stops secondary writes clobbering primary but gives secondary no value of its own). Single-window sprag-gui unaffected; per-window signal is a deferred carry (RepaintScope precedent).

Acceptance mechanisms confirmed in source: equality-skip = no notify on same value (signal.rs:83-85); is_simulating() gate in Effect::mark_dirty (effect.rs:178) suppresses dry_run/simulate; provider first-write-wins via Owner::cache (owner.rs:1113-1161). Crate home pinion-core/src/reactive/viewport.rs mirrors repaint.rs/font_metrics.rs.
Design-only round: no cargo build/test run (no code). impact_refs cite only existing sections (5.23/5.22/6.3/5.16) so no new cross-ref orphan is introduced; validate-workspace confirmed post-append.
publishable_carry_forward_bullets: Implementing round (future): pinion-core/src/reactive/viewport.rs (ViewportSizeHolder(Signal<(u32,u32)>) + VIEWPORT_SIZE_KEY + use_viewport_size); Owner::provide_viewport_size + viewport_size_signal; CoreShell viewport_signal field + (0,0) boot seed + set_viewport_size(w,h) inside root_owner.run called on primary-window paint in compute_paint_scene_internal (DEFAULT_WINDOW-gated).

Contract MUST encode the 3 corrections: (1) snapshot/AT protected by equality-skip + introspection-paints-live-size, NOT is_simulating — off-live-size snapshot must SimulationGuard; (2) consumer reflow Effect skips on the (0,0) sentinel to avoid a boot 1x1 resize; (3) primary-only — secondary window reads primary's size until a per-window signal lands.

Separate nit (out of scope): WindowEvent::Resized arm (app.rs:1681-1690) calls renderer.resize only, no request_redraw — reflow may lag to next input where the compositor does not auto-send RedrawRequested; fold a request_redraw into the implementing round.

R1012.decision_summary: R1012 §5.23 §5.22 §6.3 §5.16: per-pane viewport seam (splitter-sized pane -> producer reflow) — SPEC SEED only (design ratified + source-verified, no code); extends the R1006 window seam to N tagged Container panes; post-layout sibling using the R774 measured-viewport same-frame re-pass
changes_bullets: SPEC SEED only — no code this round; records the requirement + ratified design + source-verified gaps for a future implementing round (design-only shape like R1006 / spec-phase round-14/15). Extends the R1006 window seam to per-pane. sprag multi-pane intake.

Requirement: each pane (a tagged Scene::Container holding a TextGrid) must read its OWN measured pixel rect at view/effect-time to derive (cols,rows)=rect/cell and drive a per-pane producer reflow (PTY TIOCSWINSZ) that changes on splitter drag — the per-pane leg of the winsize SSOT producer-adoption.

Key asymmetry vs R1006: a window size is OS-known PRE-view (R1006 publishes before V::view at substrate.rs:2388), but a pane rect is layout-derived POST-view (known only after compute_layout). So the per-pane publish is post-layout — architecturally the R774 ScrollState::measured_viewport AutoSizer leg (scroll.rs:79-104), NOT the R1006 pre-view publish.

Ratified design: a tag-keyed owner-cache registry (PaneViewportRegistry holder = RefCell<BTreeMap<Cow<'static,str>, Signal<(u32,u32)>>>, mirror of ViewportSizeHolder) + use_pane_viewport_size(tag) (get-or-insert the pane's Signal, tracked get, strict Owner::current like use_viewport_size) + a shell publish that, after the final layout, resolves each registered tag's rect via Scene::rect_for_tag_absolute (scene.rs:820) and sets (w,h).

First-paint chicken-and-egg: the publish returns a pane-dirty bit reusing the existing scroll-dirty same-frame re-pass (substrate.rs:2450) so the re-run view reads post-reflow producer state on the same paint — if scroll_dirty || pane_dirty { re-view + re-layout }, idempotent via Signal equality-skip; absent tag (torn-off pane) => skip (retain last), only measured rects publish.

Contract inherited from R1006: set INSIDE root_owner.run (blocker B); (0,0)=pane-unknown sentinel => consumer skips a spurious 1x1 reflow; primary-window gate (DEFAULT_WINDOW — panes live in the primary window); introspection paint (_pure_internal / RPC produce) does NOT publish.

Sibling-not-unified: R1006 (window / pre-view / 1 global signal) and R1012 (pane / post-layout / N tag-keyed signals) stay distinct primitives — different timing + cardinality; folding window into post-layout would regress R1006's same-paint pre-reflow. use_viewport_size stays unchanged.

Forcing consumer (impl round): extend hello-dock-panels with TextGrid panes whose winsize tracks the splitter ratio (Splitter + ExtraExternal + Owner::cache ratio reuse); real consumer = sprag-gui multi-pane terminals (sprag repo, out of scope here).
verification_bullets: Verified pre-view vs post-layout split in source: R1006 set_viewport_size runs before V::view (substrate.rs:2388 then 2430); R774 ScrollState::measured_viewport is written by the layout pass post-view and read back via Signal with the scroll-dirty re-pass (scroll.rs:79-104, substrate.rs:2434-2456) — confirms per-pane is the post-layout leg, not a parametrized R1006.

Verified the readback exists: Scene::rect_for_tag_absolute(&str)->Option<Rect> (scene.rs:820) returns the post-layout resolved rect of a tagged node, and ContainerNode.tag + with_tag carry the pane id (scene.rs:1870-1940). Only w/h is consumed, so the absolute offset is irrelevant for winsize.

Verified the consumer math is reusable: CellMetric::cols_for / rows_for (cell_metric.rs:146,156) already derive (cols,rows) from a pixel extent with the same whole_cells floor SSOT as px_to_cell (R1008, cell_metric.rs:131) — the rect->winsize step is unchanged.

Verified genuinely-new substrate: no per-Container reactive size slot exists today — only window-level use_viewport_size (R1006) and ScrollState-bound measured_viewport (R774); the tag-keyed registry is new, not a duplicate (grep of crates/pinion-core/src/reactive + widgets).

Verified blocker-B (R1006) applies unchanged: the per-pane reflow Effect reads use_pane_viewport_size in an Effect; Signal::set re-runs it synchronously, so the publish must set inside root_owner.run or Owner::current().expect panics (effect.rs run_with_node pushes CURRENT_OWNER only) — same failure mode the R1006 module doc encodes.
SPEC SEED gate: no code landed; validate-workspace T1=0 expected (entries 999->1000, one new changelog row, no new orphan ref); cargo build/test/clippy unaffected (no source touched).
carry_forward_bullets: Impl round (R1012.1): pinion-core reactive/pane_viewport.rs (PaneViewportRegistry holder + use_pane_viewport_size) + Owner provide/registry accessor + shell post-layout publish + pane-dirty fold into the scroll-dirty re-pass + hello-dock-panels TextGrid-pane forcing consumer + deterministic tests; then session-review clearance.

Standing carry: real sprag-gui multi-pane consumer out of scope (sprag repo); per-window viewport signal still deferred (panes are primary-window); TUI path does not publish (1 process = 1 alternate-screen).
Sequencing: if sprag reports a fresh forcing case it preempts (stop-report -> spec-seed -> impl, like PR-2/PR-7); else continue to the Model-View epub slice after R1012.

R1012.1.decision_summary: R1012.1 §5.23 §5.22 §6.3 §5.16: implement the per-pane viewport seam — pinion-core use_pane_viewport_size tag-keyed registry + CoreShell::publish_pane_viewports post-layout publish folded into the scroll-dirty same-frame re-pass; an end-to-end 2-pane forcing-consumer test; 11 deterministic tests
changes_bullets: pinion-core reactive/pane_viewport.rs: use_pane_viewport_size(tag) hook (strict Owner::current().expect, mirror of use_viewport_size) over a tag-keyed PaneViewportRegistry (Rc<RefCell<BTreeMap<tag, Signal<(u32,u32)>>>>) lazily seeded (0,0)="pane unmeasured"; entries() snapshots the pairs before the shell set()s so a synchronous reflow Effect may re-enter the hook without a RefCell double-borrow. Module doc encodes the R1012 contract.

pinion-core Owner: pane_viewport_registry + pane_viewport_signal (both pub(crate), internal plumbing) + pane_viewport_entries (pub, public-typed snapshot the shell publishes from); crate-root re-export of use_pane_viewport_size beside use_viewport_size.

pinion-runtime CoreShell::publish_pane_viewports(&Scene)->bool: resolves each registered tag's measured rect via Scene::rect_for_tag_absolute, sets (w,h) inside root_owner.run (R1006 blocker B), returns the pane-dirty bit; a tag absent from the scene (torn-off pane) is skipped and retains its last size.

pinion-shell substrate compute_paint_scene_internal: after the final layout, primary-window-gated publish that folds pane_dirty into the existing scroll-dirty same-frame re-pass (re-view + re-layout once) so the paint reflects post-reflow producer state; the side-effect-free mirror (compute_paint_scene_pure_internal) never reaches this fn, so introspection never publishes (the R1006 contract, inherited).

R1012 contract encoded as the design ratified: post-layout sibling of the R1006 pre-view window publish (a pane size is layout-derived); (0,0) sentinel; primary-gate; blocker B; first-paint same-frame re-pass. use_viewport_size unchanged (the two seams stay distinct).

Forcing consumer crates/pinion-shell/tests/pane_viewport_seam.rs: a 2-pane 3:5 horizontal split where the root fills the window via R1006 use_viewport_size and each pane reflows a mock PTY via R1012 use_pane_viewport_size, driven end-to-end through ShellCore::compute_paint_scene (the live publish path). Runnable GUI example deferred: the seam is live-paint-only (not RPC/headlessly verifiable in this env, like R1006's sprag consumer) so the end-to-end test is the verifiable forcing consumer.
verification_bullets: 11 new deterministic tests, all passing: 7 pane_viewport module (lazy (0,0) sentinel, shared-handle get-or-insert, distinct-tag independence, use-hook resolves inside Owner::run, reflow Effect re-fires on set, re-entrant read without double-borrow, equality-skip inert) + 1 CoreShell publish (per-pane reflow to ITS rect, dirty-bit return, equality-skip republish, per-pane independence [move only left -> only left re-fires], absent-tag skip) + 3 end-to-end via compute_paint_scene.

End-to-end witnesses the per-pane differentiator (the value R1006's window seam alone cannot give): at a 640px window the 3:5 split reflows left=30x24 and right=50x24 (different), and the painted grids carry those dims on the SAME paint (the pane-dirty re-pass), not one frame late; a resize to 800px re-divides to 37x24 / 62x24 and re-fires each pane once; an unchanged repaint is inert (no re-fire, no re-pass loop).

R1012.2.decision_summary: R1012.2 §5.23 §5.22 §6.3 §5.16: session-review clearance of R1012.1 (2 independent adversarial reviewers + grep audit) — fixed 1 HIGH (test-mutex poison cascade) + 4 MED (boundary off-by-one coverage, collapsed-pane, convergence-invariant doc, registry-bound doc) + 2 LOW; rejected 3 over-scope items with documented reasons
changes_bullets: HIGH (ZERO-FLAKE): the forcing-consumer test's TEST_LOCK/PTY_LOG lock().unwrap() poisoned on a failing assert held across the guard, cascading one real failure into confusing PoisonErrors across the file's tests; de-poisoned every access (unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner)) + snapshot-clone the log before asserting so no guard is held across an assert.

MED (R988.1 off-by-one class): the 640/800 happy-path widths are exact multiples of both the 3:5 split AND the 8px cell, so neither flex-rounding nor the cols_for floor ever bit; added a non-divisible 638px boundary test (lays out 239px:399px -> 29:49 cols, empirically pinned) so a flex-round x winsize-floor regression cannot hide.

MED: a pane collapsed to 0px (splitter dragged shut) makes rect_for_tag_absolute return None, so the publish skips it and the pane retains its last size (no degenerate 0-col reflow) — added the CoreShell test case + documented it distinct from the (0,0) "unmeasured" boot sentinel.

MED: documented the single-publish convergence invariant (one re-pass converges only for layout-derived, content-independent pane rects — the splitter model) and softened the module doc's R774 parity claim (R1012 re-walks the laid-out scene via rect_for_tag_absolute rather than fusing the write into the layout pass as set_measured_viewport does; the fused harvest is a deferred optimisation).

MED: documented the registry as insert-only (bounded by distinct tags ever seen, fits the fixed-dock consumer; a release_pane eviction for dynamic tear-off at scale is deferred until a real such consumer needs it) — no longer framing the skip-retain as an unqualified feature.

LOW: added the negative blocker-B test (set outside an owner scope panics in use_pane_viewport_size, mirror of viewport.rs) + the inherited is_simulating() secondary-defense line to module-doc item 3 + softened the "no re-pass loop" wording (the re-pass is a single if, not a loop — equality-skip floors the dirty bit).

RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D warnings cargo doc (core+runtime+shell) = 0 new R1012 breaks (217 pre-existing pinion-core doc debt is a separate carry).

The 638px boundary value was empirically pinned, not assumed: taffy lays out the 3:5 split of 638 to 239px:399px and cols_for floors the trailing partial cell to 29:49 cols (the test asserts both the producer dims and the painted-grid dims, proving publish + paint read the same rect so a non-cell-aligned pane never diverges hit-vs-paint).

Applied verify-seed-claims to the reviewers too: the 0-width None path and the taffy 638px values were traced in source / pinned empirically before accepting, and 3 reviewer suggestions were rejected as over-scope (see carry).
carry_forward_bullets: Deferred with reason (rejected as over-scope, not defects): fuse the pane-rect harvest into the layout pass (a perf optimisation, premature without a measured cost or a 2nd consumer); a release_pane registry eviction (no dynamic-tear-off-at-scale consumer yet — YAGNI / abstraction-needs-2nd-consumer); factoring the 3x view+layout re-pass blocks in compute_paint_scene_internal (an established 7x file idiom — a repo-wide cleanup, out of a feature round's scope).

Standing carry: real sprag-gui multi-pane terminal consumer out of scope (sprag repo); per-window viewport signal deferred (panes are primary-window); the TUI path does not publish; a runnable GUI example deferred as non-headlessly-verifiable (the publish is live-paint-only, like R1006's sprag consumer) — the end-to-end test is the verifiable forcing consumer.

R1012.3.decision_summary: R1012.3 §5.23 §5.22 §6.3 §5.16: user session-review clearance under a cost-no-object textbook bar (2 fresh adversarial reviewers [system-architect + refactoring-expert] + grep audit) — fixed 6 real items (doc-link warts, redundant accessor, R774-mischaracterization doc, scroll-clip doc, dead arm, 3x re-pass dedup); rejected 5 over-reach/artifact findings with traced evidence
changes_bullets: M1 (doc): removed 3 redundant/misleading explicit doc-link targets in the publish_pane_viewports / set_viewport_size docs ([`Signal`] / [`Signal::set`] now bare intra-doc; the explicit (pinion_core::Signal) was redundant for Signal and misleading for ::set, pointing at the type). cargo doc is not in the commit gate so they slipped through R1012.1/.2.

M2 (API-surface SSOT): dropped the redundant Owner::pane_viewport_signal one-line delegator; use_pane_viewport_size + the unit tests now reach the signal through the single pane_viewport_registry().signal_for path (mirrors R1006's single-accessor surface; the prior two paths could drift).

HIGH-1 (doc accuracy): rewrote the module doc that mischaracterized R774. R774's update_scroll_state_bounds harvests INSIDE compute_layout because a ScrollNode carries its ScrollState in the SCENE (ScrollNode.state); a pane's viewport Signal is owner-cache-keyed (a Container carries only a tag, panes are sparse), so the harvest correctly lives in the SHELL (the one layer holding both scene + owner), not as a deferred optimisation. Folding it into compute_layout would couple the layout pass to the reactive owner -- a coupling the scene-carried scroll path lacks.
L1 (doc): noted rect_for_tag_absolute -> None also covers a scroll-clipped pane, which the seam's top-level-splitter-pane model scopes out.
L2: replaced the dead `_ => "pane.reflow"` arm in the test fixture with unreachable!().

MED-4 (dedup): factored the 3x identical V::view / view_for_window dispatch in compute_paint_scene_internal into one block-scoped closure capturing only &self.core (disjoint from the &mut self.text_cache the layouts borrow). View-only -- NOT view+layout (which would double-lay-out the first pass) -- consistent with dispatch_rpc's existing text_cache-ptr closure.
verification_bullets: cargo test --workspace = 7203 ok 0 fail (real exit 0; unchanged count -- doc/dedup/accessor edits add no tests). clippy --workspace --all-targets --features pinion-runtime/vello = 0. RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D warnings cargo doc: 0 new R1012 breaks AND my 3 M1 warts cleared (the remaining core_shell.rs:1280 [`Effect`] redundant-link is pre-existing R1006 debt, left under scope-discipline).

The dedup closure compiles via edition-2024 disjoint capture (&self.core shared inside the closure coexists with &mut self.text_cache in the layout calls); it is block-scoped so its borrow drops before the later &mut self paint-loop work; behavior is byte-identical (the 8 module + 1 runtime + 4 integration R1012 tests still pass, incl. the same-frame re-pass and resize cases).

Self-corrected mid-review (verify-seed-claims on my own edit): a bare [`use_viewport_size`] edit on a pre-existing R1006 line produced an unresolved-link error (use_viewport_size is not imported in core_shell), so I reverted it -- only my own R1012 doc was touched.

REJECTED findings, traced (verify-seed-claims applied to the two reviewers): HIGH-0 uncommitted-non-compiling-substrate = a PARALLEL-REVIEW RACE ARTIFACT (I ran two tree-mutating review agents concurrently; one saw the other's in-flight compile experiment). Committed HEAD + working tree are clean and compile. Process lesson: never run tree-mutating review agents in parallel.

HIGH-1 structural (fuse into compute_layout): rejected -- ScrollState is scene-carried (ScrollNode.state, verified scene.rs:2287) so the scroll harvest needs no owner; the pane registry is owner-cache, so fusing would add a layout->reactive-owner coupling scroll lacks. rect_for_tag_absolute is reuse of an established scroll-aware primitive; SSOT not violated (it READS Container.rect, never re-derives); perf negligible at realistic pane counts.

MED-1 (unify window+pane registry, window=reserved key): rejected -- pre-view(window) vs post-layout(pane) are genuinely different publish mechanisms (the reviewer concedes the timing asymmetry is load-bearing); unifying forces reserved-key magic and reworks shipped+reviewed R1006 for marginal dedup; the parallel test suites exercise different timing, not duplicated logic.

MED-2/3 (eviction + per-window homing): a valid FUTURE axis, deferred not on cost but because the correct policy needs a real tear-off consumer -- evict-on-scene-absence is unsafe transiently (a pane absent one paint loses its size), safe only once homed per-window (R680 cascade-drop). Registry is bounded by distinct tags for current fixed-dock consumers.

MED-5 (introspection): the pane RECT is already AI-introspectable (tagged Container -> scene/bbox) and a TextGrid pane exposes cols/rows from its rect; an External producer's derived PTY dims are that producer's introspection surface, not this seam's. Out of scope.
carry_forward_bullets: Standing carry unchanged: real sprag-gui multi-pane consumer out of repo; per-window viewport signal deferred; TUI no-publish; runnable GUI example deferred (live-paint-only seam, not headlessly verifiable).

Named future axis (not speculative): a per-window-homed, self-pruning pane-viewport registry when a dynamic dock-tear-off consumer lands -- evict tags absent from the window's scene, homed via R680 window_owner cascade-drop (the MED-2/3 reviewer approach, recorded for that round).

Next: if sprag reports a fresh forcing case it preempts; else the Model-View epub slice. R1012 is now textbook-cleared across two adversarial passes (R1012.2 quality/correctness + R1012.3 architecture/SSOT); PUSH PENDING explicit user consent.

R1013.decision_summary: R1013 §5.41: wide TextGrid head glyph survives the trailer background — two-pass paint (all cell backgrounds, then all glyphs) fixes the draw-order overpaint that clipped overflowing CJK/full-width glyphs (the 'compression' symptom), not a font mis-size
changes_bullets: pinion-runtime paint_adapter::paint_text_grid split into two grid-wide passes: pass 1 fills every cell background, pass 2 draws every glyph + SGR decoration on top (was one interleaved per-cell loop)

Root cause was draw-order overpaint, not font mis-size: a wide head glyph renders at its natural ~1em advance, overflows into the trailer column, and the trailer's opaque bg fill (emitted next in the old loop) erased that overflow, reading as horizontal "compression"

Docstring + font-policy note corrected: overpaint (the visible "compression") fixed; a metric-matched CJK fallback (em == 2*cell_w exact span fill) stays a separate open question; glyph horizontal scale/centre remains rejected (R1002 distortion). TUI unchanged (skips trailers; terminal renders the wide head across two columns)
verification_bullets: New pinion-shell headless-GPU witness r1013_text_grid_wide_head_glyph_survives_trailer_bg: font-independent ("W" marked wide + pinned 40px over a 12px cell forces overflow, white-on-black ink probe) — FAILS pre-fix on the trailer column, PASSES post-fix
All 13 headless-GPU pixel tests pass incl r995 cross-consistency + r991/r992/r993 wide/SGR/cursor (no regression)
cargo test pinion-runtime 2495 / pinion-tui 357 / pinion-core 108 = 0 failed; clippy --workspace --all-targets --features pinion-runtime/vello = 0; validate-workspace T1=0
carry_forward_bullets: Metric-matched CJK/emoji fallback face (em pinned to 2*cell_w) so a wide glyph exactly FILLS its 2-cell span — post-R1013 it renders un-clipped but may under-fill; exact fill needs a paired font (per-cell uniform up-sizing risks cell_h overflow), a font-asset/policy slice not a paint bug
Two-pass also protects any other overflowing glyph (italic overhang, emoji) from a neighbour cell's bg overpaint — no further paint action needed

R1021.decision_summary: R1021 §5.23 §5.22 §5.16: per-window pane-viewport publish — removed the DEFAULT_WINDOW gate on CoreShell::publish_pane_viewports in compute_paint_scene_internal so every painted window publishes the rects of the tags it draws. The pane registry is root_owner-scoped + tag-keyed (window-agnostic); a tag absent from a window's scene resolves rect_for_tag_absolute None and is skipped (foreign panes never clobbered). A torn-off (undock) pane reflows to its secondary window via layout root-fill — no per-window use_viewport_size needed. Forcing consumer: sprag R37 undock. The R1006 window-size seam stays DEFAULT_WINDOW-gated (bullet 1 deferred — no consumer + collides with the R680 root-scope view-fn decision).
changes_bullets: compute_paint_scene_internal (pinion-shell/src/substrate.rs): removed the `window_key == DEFAULT_WINDOW &&` guard on the publish_pane_viewports re-pass — the per-pane viewport publish now runs for EVERY painted window. The R1006 set_viewport_size publish above stays DEFAULT_WINDOW-gated (unchanged).

Why per-window is safe: the pane registry (pinion-core reactive/pane_viewport.rs) is root_owner-scoped + tag-keyed = window-agnostic. rect_for_tag_absolute returns None for a tag absent from the painting window's scene, so publish_pane_viewports skips it (retains last measured size — a foreign window's pane is never clobbered). Dock model = one tag drawn in one window at a time, so there is no ambiguity.

Why no per-window use_viewport_size is needed: compute_layout forces the root to fill the (w,h) viewport (the root's declared size is ignored at the top level, <html>-style), so a secondary window's content fills its window and the pane Container's measured rect IS the window rect. A torn-off pane reflows via the pane seam, not the window seam.

Scope (PR-10 review outcome): only the pane-viewport gate (bullet 2) is removed. Per-window use_viewport_size (bullet 1) is DEFERRED — no in-repo/sprag consumer needs the window-size seam to differ per window, and it collides with the ratified R680 decision to run every window's view fn under root_owner (so there is no per-window owner scope a consumer could resolve from).

R1021.1.decision_summary: R1021.1 §5.23 §5.16: pane-publish review clearance — documented the unchecked precondition on CoreShell::publish_pane_viewports (a pane tag is drawn in at most one window per frame). The registry is tag-keyed because the consumer resolves under the binding-wide root_owner with no window to disambiguate by (R680), so per-(window,tag) keying is impossible — the same wall as the deferred window-size seam; a tag in two windows is last-writer-wins and the dock model satisfies the precondition by construction. Added same_tag_in_two_windows_is_last_writer_wins to pin the consequence.
changes_bullets: core_shell.rs publish_pane_viewports doc: new "Precondition (unchecked)" section — a pane tag is drawn in at most one window per frame. The registry is tag-keyed (one shared signal per tag) because the consumer use_pane_viewport_size resolves under the binding-wide root_owner (every window's view fn runs there, R680) and so has no window to disambiguate by; per-(window,tag) keying is therefore impossible — the same window-discriminator wall as the deferred window-size seam. A tag drawn in two windows is last-writer-wins and would oscillate across alternating frames; the dock/tear-off model satisfies the precondition by construction (the primary drops a pane when it floats). A future "mirror one pane in N windows" feature cannot use this seam as-is.

pane_viewport_seam.rs: same_tag_in_two_windows_is_last_writer_wins test — primary draws LEFT (30x24), the float window also draws LEFT (40x12, clobbers the shared signal), re-painting the primary flips it back (30x24). Pins the precondition's teeth so it is explicit + tested rather than a silently-assumed prose invariant.

R1022.decision_summary: R1022 §5.39 §5.16: focus-ring far-edge framebuffer clamp — build_focus_ring_box now clamps the ring bottom/right edges into the framebuffer (sibling of the R806 top/left near-edge clamp), so a widget flush against the window's bottom/right edge keeps all four ring strokes on-screen instead of rasterising the far strokes off-screen. The shell threads the layout viewport (w,h) through apply_focus_ring -> inject_styled_focus_ring -> inject_focus_ring. The default Inside border alignment lands the clamped stroke fully visible. Forcing consumer: sprag full-bleed multi-pane terminal (the focused pane showed only 3 of its 4 ring edges).
changes_bullets: build_focus_ring_box (pinion-overlay/src/focus_ring.rs) gains fb_w/fb_h and clamps the ring far edges: right=min(ideal_right,fb_w), bottom=min(ideal_bottom,fb_h). A far-flush edge has no outward room so the ring INSETS (same shape as the R807 top flood-row inset, not a mirror of the near saturating_sub). The default Inside border alignment draws the whole stroke within the box rect, so a far edge clamped to the framebuffer lands the stroke fully visible. A 0 framebuffer extent (unknown/headless) disables the far clamp so the ring is never collapsed to zero.

Threaded the framebuffer (layout viewport) extent through the chain: inject_focus_ring (pub) + inject_styled_focus_ring + ShellCore::apply_focus_ring all take (w,h); the shell passes the same (w,h) it fed compute_layout. Callers updated: 2 apply_focus_ring sites + the RPC produce path + 2 headless_screenshot tests + 14 overlay unit tests (the tests pass their 1000x1000 container size, so existing assertions stay byte-identical).

Non-flush widgets and top/left-flush widgets (R806 near-edge) are byte-unchanged: the far clamp is a no-op when ideal_far <= framebuffer. The same paint scene feeds the renderer and scene/snapshot from:paint, so the clamped ring rect is introspectable (§2 #7 preserved).
verification_bullets: 3 new pinion-overlay tests: ring_clamps_far_edges_into_framebuffer_at_bottom_right_corner (a full-bleed 200x100 pane -> ring all 4 edges <= framebuffer), ring_far_clamp_is_per_axis (bottom-flush only; the right edge stays concentric), ring_far_clamp_disabled_for_zero_framebuffer. The R806 near-edge guards (ring_stays_concentric_at_top_left_flush_corner, ring_clips_only_the_overflowing_axis) stay byte-identical: 16 overlay tests ok.

GPU screenshot ring tests pass with --ignored on the real vello rasterizer: r806_focus_ring_top_edge_rasterizes_two_px_not_thick + r706_cached_render_frames_focused_day_cell_not_next_column (ring rects in-bounds, unchanged).

R1023.decision_summary: R1023 §5.16: winit Resized requests a redraw — the WindowEvent::Resized arm now calls window.request_redraw() right after renderer.resize(), so a live drag-resize repaints the reconfigured swapchain each size step instead of presenting a stale backbuffer until an unrelated redraw arrives (the full-bleed ghosting sprag-gui observed). Mirrors the existing request_inner_size + request_redraw pairing; per-window (R670.B). Forcing consumer: sprag-gui live drag-resize. Paint-layer fix: compile/clippy-verified + precedent-mirrored; live visual confirmation is a manual real-window check.
changes_bullets: app.rs WindowEvent::Resized arm: match RenderState::Active { renderer, window, .. } and call window.request_redraw() immediately after renderer.resize(). Per-window (R670.B) — only the resized window repaints. winit coalesces repeated request_redraw before the next RedrawRequested, so a fast drag costs at most one paint per frame.

Mirrors the two request_inner_size sites that already pair a size change with request_redraw ("the explicit request_redraw shortens the gap"); the user-driven winit Resized arm was the missing sibling. Root cause: winit does not auto-emit RedrawRequested after Resized, so the reconfigured swapchain presented a stale/undefined backbuffer until an unrelated redraw arrived.
verification_bullets: cargo check -p pinion-shell clean. clippy --workspace --all-targets --features pinion-runtime/vello = 0.

NOT headlessly unit-testable: the Resized arm needs a live winit Window + GPU renderer slot (the existing app.rs tests cover only pure winit->pinion mapping helpers, not the ApplicationHandler event loop). The fix mirrors the established request_inner_size precedent exactly.

Live drag-resize visual confirmation (no ghosting on full-bleed content) is a manual real-window check, NOT performed in this headless session; the code fix + precedent are the headless evidence (never-record-unverified-outcomes).

R1023.1.decision_summary: R1023.1 §5.16: redraw-idiom documentation clearance — documented the two redraw-request idioms at drain_redraw_to_winit (the coalescing chokepoint): ledger route (request_redraw / request_redraw_for_window for triggers that cannot name their window — state/RPC/animation/external) vs direct poke (winit-event arms holding the Arc<Window> — Resized, request_inner_size). winit coalesces both to one paint per frame; the direct form skips a ledger round-trip when the window is in hand. Converts the entrenched two-idiom split from tribal knowledge to documented design.

carry_forward_bullets: Addresses the architect-LOW / root-cause session-review finding (two redraw idioms with no documented rule). R1023's direct poke matches the request_inner_size precedent; the selection rule is now documented at the drain chokepoint rather than tribal knowledge.

R1028.1.decision_summary: R1028.1 §5.41 §2 #6 adversarial-review clearance (3 reviewers): the R1028 pass-0 default-bg fill ran AFTER the grid.is_empty() early-return, so a geometry-only grid (a documented TextGridNode::new state: sized rect, 0x0 cells — and the transient first frame before a consumer pushes its buffer) still leaked the parent surface across its whole rect, contradicting R1028's stated goal. Fix: move the clip push + pass-0 fill before the empty-grid early-out (balance the clip + return). New r1028_1 GPU test places an empty grid at a NON-ZERO rect origin, pinning both empty-grid completeness and the pass-0 coordinate frame (inside=default bg, outside-clip=parent clear); negative-control verified. Other review findings: opaque-by-construction (no transparent-bg regression), TUI parity intact (char-cell has no sub-pixel gutter), and the standing CI gap that #[ignore] GPU tests never run in ci.yml (project-wide, not R1028-specific, left as-is).

This contradicts the r806_1 test's own 'in vello not the adapter' attribution — the flood IS adapter-specific (recorded as a follow-up).

R1030.decision_summary: R1030 §5.39 fail-safe focusable defaults: interactive widget *helpers* now default focusable=true (web native-element model — a button/menu/toolbar/tree/table/disclosure/datepicker/tabs is a Tab stop without an explicit opt-in; opt OUT via .with_focusable(false) for modal/decorative). Fixes the demo-sweep tag_not_focusable regression that has been red since R1020: R1020 retired the focusable_tags() enumeration for scene-derived LayoutStyle::focusable, but its opt-in conversion missed ~28 demos and the view_menu_bar menubar node, silently dropping interactive widgets from the Tab order (and from AI focus introspection) — a fail-DANGEROUS default. R1030 flips 7 widget-style defaults, adds a focusable field to TabsStyle, fixes the view_menu_bar helper-node gap, and adds per-example opt-in for hand-composed focus nodes (rating, tree invisible-root, raw slider/stepper/etc. containers). Decision driver: per the user's textbook/SSOT/north-star directive, fail-safe (web-aligned, AI-introspection-critical) over R1020's fail-dangerous default-false. Out of scope (separate pre-existing bugs surfaced or unrelated): r674 Space-toggle, r957/r962/r972/r987 text-band layout, immediate-mode demos.

R1030.2.decision_summary: R1030.2 §5.39 fix the R1030 over-enumeration regression in hello-tree-view (demo r674): R1030 flipped TreeViewStyle.focusable default to true, so the painted tree container (file_tree) became a SECOND focus stop alongside the binding's invisible keyboard root (tree_root, which apply_key gates on). A row click then moved shell focus onto file_tree, and the Space/Arrow gate (focused != tree_root -> reject) silently dropped keys — r674's click-then-Space sequence failed deterministically (surfaced only once R1030 made tree_root focusable; previously it errored earlier at tag_not_focusable). Fix: this binding deliberately routes keyboard focus through the invisible root, so the painted container opts OUT via TreeViewStyle::m3_default().with_focusable(false) — exactly the fail-safe-default opt-out case. Verified r674 PASS 2/2; r673/r809/r823 still PASS.

R1031.decision_summary: R1031 §5.37 fix the text-band demo-sweep cluster (r962/r987/r957) — a real layout bug in logical_line_span (pinion-text/caret.rs): it picked the FIRST visual row whose box [y, y+height) contains caret_y, but when the resolved font's natural line box exceeds the advance step the row boxes OVERLAP (DejaVu Sans Mono's first row has a negative top that extends into row 1's top), so line N's caret-top matched row N-1's box and the current-line band collapsed onto the previous logical line (the non-increasing [79,79,99,...] band tops; invisible on Noto CJK Mono, whose boxes are contiguous). Fix: select the LAST containing row via rposition (the row starting at-or-above caret_y), robust to overlapping/negative boxes; + an overlapping-box regression test. Also made two demos font-robust (r1002-class fragility, not layer bugs): r987 asserted band step == band height (false when boxes overlap — step <= height now) and r972 hardcoded the measured grid's font-derived cell (9x18) and dims (40x20) — now asserts the winsize round-trip against the node's own cell_w/cell_h (htg_default's fixed 8x16 stays pinned). Verified r957/r962/r972/r987 PASS under forced DejaVu (CI font) AND Noto.

R1045.decision_summary: §5.45 §5.49 §5.38 GUI-side apply_wheel seam (sprag PR-18, consumer-forced): WidgetCore::apply_wheel(scene, cursor, delta, modifiers)->bool (default false), offered as stage 0 inside CoreShell::wheel_with_modifiers_for_window BEFORE the router two-stage (hover-External offer + Scene::Scroll fallback). A binding whose scroll authority is a ROW-granular view-state (terminal scrollback re-projected by offset_lines, not a pixel-clip Scene::Scroll) is served by NEITHER router stage: stage 1 pushes the wheel into the hovered producer External (embedding the human viewport offset in an AI-facing engine that carries no scene state = R1.7 layering violation), stage 2 needs a Scene::Scroll pixel-clip node a row-reprojected grid has none of. Position-bearing like apply_secondary_click — cursor, not focus, is the discriminator (wheel targets what is under the pointer, W3C/desktop), so 'focused' was dropped from the proposed signature. Placing the offer at the single runtime chokepoint (not the keyboard backend-orders split) is a DELIBERATE divergence: the wheel router is one stateful call (sub-pixel wheel_remainders carry inside it) with no clean shell-level interposition point, so the precedence is stated once and covers Vello/TUI/RPC scene-wheel uniformly. sprag terminal-pane scroll = forcing consumer.

R1047.decision_summary: §5.23 §5.22 §6.3 WidgetCore::reconcile_frame — per-paint pre-view binding reducer hook (sprag PR-20, consumer-forced; offset-projection scroll-bound reconcile). A binding whose scroll authority is an offset-projection (a Scene::TextGrid re-projecting scrollback by offset_lines, NOT a Scene::Scroll pixel clip) whose content extent (scrollback_len) lives in an off-thread producer with no reactive Signal: the post-layout update_scroll_state_bounds reducer cannot reach it (no clip node, extent not layout-derived) and no Effect can subscribe (no dep). reconcile_frame() is the sanctioned non-view-fn place to grow + tail-follow its ScrollState, so V::view stays a pure read (the §6.3 dry_run guarantee). Run pre-view (after set_viewport_size, before V::view, under root_owner) — no re-pass since a producer-derived extent needs no measured viewport. Chose B (binding hook) over A (extend the declarative reducer): only the binding knows the producer extent + the tail-follow timing; A would force off-thread producer counts into the scene. Coherent sibling of R1045 apply_wheel. EXCLUDED from the side-effect-free pure mirror (compute_paint_scene_pure_internal) — a scene/snapshot or dry_run never reconciles (§6.3 / §2 #3 by construction).

R1048.decision_summary: §5.49 apply_wheel laid-out paint scene (sprag PR-18.1, a fix to the shipped R1045 apply_wheel). R1045's doc said the binding 'hit-tests cursor to the pane it owns', but the call site passed &mut self.scene = the un-laid-out model/state scene (the compose-root of input Externals): pane tags are paint-tree constructs absent from it and its nodes carry only zero rects, so rect_for_tag_absolute resolved None for every pane tag and a multi-pane binding could not map cursor->pane (a single-pane terminal never exposed the gap). The router itself hit-tests against last_paint_scene (the laid-out paint tree), not the state scene. Fix: apply_wheel's first param becomes paint:&Scene = the router's last_paint_scene (read-only), so the binding hit-tests cursor against pane rects via rect_for_tag_absolute on the same laid-out basis the router uses. Narrowed &mut->& deliberately (the wheel action mutates reactive scroll authority via a use_* hook, not the scene; External mutation stays on the router stage-1 offer_wheel_to_external path). Stage-0 now also gates on last_paint_scene() being present, which incidentally closes the R1045 arch-review LOW no-paint-scene nit.

R1049.decision_summary: §5.16 codegen renderer surface-invalidation recovery (sprag PR-21). The vello_renderer_impl! template (pinion-forge codegen) recovered from a non-presentable swapchain status by log+skip only, never reconfiguring — so an invalidated X11 surface stayed broken every frame, AND a stale-but-Success texture's create_view raised a wgpu validation error that wgpu's default uncaptured-error handler turned into a hard process panic (live-repro 2x during scrollbar drag/wheel repaints; boot/idle fine, frequent present/acquire exposes the latent gap). Two fixes: (1) the Outdated/Lost/Validation render arms now call context.configure_surface(&surface) [vello 0.9's surface.configure(device,&config)] before returning the labelled Surface error, so the next frame acquires a fresh swapchain (Timeout/Occluded are NOT surface losses -> still skip without reconfigure, matching wgpu's own variant guidance); (2) new() installs device.on_uncaptured_error(Arc::new(|e| eprintln!)) so a transient validation error is logged not panicked. GPU-window-only; the headless/RPC north-star path never compiles this renderer. Verified against vello 0.9 + wgpu 29 registry source; generated renderer compiles via forge-counter; 1-lens GPU-correctness review SHIP.

R1059.decision_summary: R1059 §5.16 SizeStrategy::OpenResizable -- decouple window open-size from the OS-resize floor (PR-23 consumer-forced seam from sprag R55 undock). New #[non_exhaustive] additive variant {size, min:Option}: opens at size with no post-paint resize; floor=min, or None=OS-native-minimum so the window can shrink below its open size. Fixed/IntrinsicAfterFirstPaint byte-unchanged via the lifted min_inner_floor() SSOT both the live + headless app.rs paths consume.
changes_bullets: lib.rs: SizeStrategy gains OpenResizable { size:(u32,u32), min:Option<(u32,u32)> } -- additive variant on the #[non_exhaustive] enum, so every existing Fixed/IntrinsicAfterFirstPaint construction + the #[pinion::widget(initial_size)] derive emit stays source-unchanged (seed (b) over seed (a)'s field-add which would break all Fixed literals)

lib.rs: lift min_inner_floor(self)->Option<(u32,u32)> as the single source of truth for the winit set_min_inner_size floor; Fixed=Some(open), IntrinsicAfterFirstPaint=Some(min), OpenResizable=min (None = no explicit floor); initial_logical_size gains OpenResizable=>size arm

app.rs live window-create: inline min_floor match replaced by strategy.min_inner_floor(); None skips with_min_inner_size so winit leaves the window at the OS-native minimum -- the freely-shrinkable case (drag below open size no longer blocked)

app.rs: pending_intrinsic_resize folds OpenResizable into the Fixed no-post-paint-resize arm; headless screenshot path paints OpenResizable once at its open size like Fixed (floor is a live-winit-only concern, no headless effect)
verification_bullets: 4 new headless unit tests (pinion-shell lib.rs): Fixed floors at open size + IntrinsicAfterFirstPaint floors at min (pre-R1059 regression guards) / OpenResizable opens at size with an independent SMALLER floor / OpenResizable{min:None} reports no floor = the freely-shrinkable acceptance criterion

the live winit drag-floor itself is not headless-observable, but the floor POLICY (the only thing PR-23 changes) is fully covered via the lifted min_inner_floor() SSOT both the live window-create and the headless screenshot path consume

R1062.decision_summary: R1062 audit-clearance (3 adversarial reviewers -- system-architect / refactoring / quality -- over R1059-R1061). Architecture judged textbook + north-star-aligned, SSOT upheld for the readback/encode lifts; cleared the 2 SHOULD-FIX items I introduced + NITs. (A) BUG: pending_capture stale-flag leak -- capture_window_screenshot now OWNS set+unconditional-clear (single-owner), so an early-return render_window (minimized/suspended window) cannot leave it stale and make the next vsync paint capture by surprise. (B) dead-code/SSOT-split: the orphaned screenshot() stub fn (handler had inlined its path validation) deleted + path-shape contract relifted as validate_screenshot_path() SSOT + stale module doc rewritten + dead pub re-export dropped. NITs: present-cycle comment corrected to the real reason (codegen-boundary constraint, mirror-not-lift) + template field-ABI comment + CapturedFrame Debug-only + out_path Read-side-effect note.
changes_bullets: BUG (quality reviewer): app.rs pending_capture flag -- capture_window_screenshot now OWNS the set+clear lifecycle and clears UNCONDITIONALLY after render_window (render_window only reads it). Fixes a stale-flag leak: a scene/screenshot on a minimized / 0-size / suspended window early-returns from render_window WITHOUT consuming the flag, so the NEXT event-loop paint would capture by surprise (multi-MB readback + blocking device.poll on the 60-144fps hot path + an orphaned frame), breaking the advertised hot-path-byte-identical guarantee

dead code / SSOT-split (refactoring reviewer): the pinion-rpc screenshot() stub fn was orphaned when R1060 inlined its path validation into handle_scene_screenshot -- it stayed pub-re-exported (dead-code-lint-invisible) carrying a now-false 'v0 always errors' doc, with the path-shape contract split across two homes. Deleted the fn + dropped the pub re-export + relifted the contract as validate_screenshot_path() SSOT (handler calls it) + rewrote the stale module header. Path-shape tests retargeted to validate_screenshot_path (empty/prefix valid, tail=UnsupportedPath, malformed=Path -- preserves the deleted stub's coverage)

NITs: vello_capture present-cycle comment corrected -- the render()/capture duplication is a codegen-boundary CONSTRAINT (forge emits vello-only code with no shared-symbol path to pinion-shell; a leaf crate would force the dep onto ~130 example Cargo.tomls), a STANDING mirror-not-lift obligation, NOT a deferred 'co-lift' choice; codegen template gains a field-ABI comment (context/surface/renderer are a macro-consumed ABI); CapturedFrame is Debug-only (dropped speculative Clone/PartialEq/Eq -- production only moves it); out_path file write documented as the one side-effect on the Read-kind method
verification_bullets: realgpu re-verify: capture unchanged after the fixes -- PINION_HIDDEN_WINDOW hello-button scene/screenshot -> 320x200, 210 distinct colors (the single-owner flag lifecycle + the handler's validate_screenshot_path SSOT are behavior-preserving on the happy path)

8 screenshot tests green (4 validate_screenshot_path path-shape: empty/prefix valid, tail=UnsupportedPath, malformed=Path; + 4 dispatch handler). The stale-flag BUG is eliminated structurally by the unconditional caller-side clear; an AppShell-orchestration regression test needs a winit EventLoopProxy (=$DISPLAY = CI flake) so it was NOT added (zero-flake policy)
cargo test --workspace -j2: 7459 pass 0 fail (unchanged: 4 deleted-stub tests + 4 added validate tests net to 0); clippy --workspace --all-targets vello 0 warn; rustfmt clean; validate T1 orphan=0

carry_forward_bullets: STANDING mirror-not-lift obligation: any future R1049-class surface-recovery change MUST land in BOTH codegen.rs::render and vello_capture::capture_surface_rgba8 (they straddle the forge/shell codegen boundary, no shared-symbol lift point)

R1063.decision_summary: R1063 §5.37 -> production-paint seam (first wire): the self-hosted text engine's CPU Coverage AA mask now reaches real pixels. coverage_to_image_data (Coverage -> peniko::ImageData, straight-alpha RGBA8, mask-alpha x brush-colour) + draw_coverage (blit via vello draw_image at pen+left/top) in paint_adapter, reusing Vello's existing image-texture path instead of a hand-rolled wgpu glyph atlas. pinion-text-font becomes an optional pinion-runtime dep gated to the vello feature. Deliberately NOT rewiring the production Scene::Text arm off the §5.36 parley/swash bridge (wholesale swap risks Phase-B text regression) — this round delivers the seam + a CPU ZERO-FLAKE gate + a realgpu (lavapipe) forcing consumer only.

avoid regressing Phase-B text editing: caret / metrics / selection / fallback parity).

R1063.1.decision_summary: R1063.1 adversarial session-review clearance of R1063 (2 independent read-only reviewers: quality-engineer = correctness/test-rigor, system-architect = SSOT/north-star). Cleared 4 real findings, rejected over-flags with evidence. (1) coverage_to_image_data floored mask*color.a/255 where the same a*b/255 op rounds-to-nearest across the §5.37 pipeline (shape::over +127, raster +0.5) -> +127 round + CPU test (200*200->157). (2) the realgpu forcing consumer's bbox-subset-footprint assertion passed a solid-rectangle (shape-blind) impl -> added a glyph-negative-space assertion. (3) the seam docstring conflated the cacheable per-glyph GlyphAtlas (§5.37.9, the production GPU-text primitive) with the whole-paragraph composite it blits -> relabeled BRING-UP, next seam targets the atlas (composite flattens it away; must not become the Scene::Text primitive). (4) sharpened the deferred-rewire framing to a multi-round campaign. Over-flags rejected: conversion crate-placement correct (peniko type can't live in the zero-dep engine); test-only consumer = prescribed forcing-consumer pattern; ImageData construction = 2nd consumer (premature to lift); alpha format / placement / cast safety / empty-None verified correct.

R1064.decision_summary: R1064 §5.39 §5.16 PR-25 per-window keyboard-focus enumeration union (sprag undock): the binding-wide FocusManager tab_order is the UNION of every painted window's focusable tags, no longer DEFAULT_WINDOW-gated, so a torn-off pane drawn only in its secondary window is focusable on click and its External (PTY) receives keyboard input. Keyed per window (R1021 publish_pane_viewports precedent); union-not-replace prevents a secondary paint clobbering the primary's docked panes.
changes_bullets: Removed the DEFAULT_WINDOW gate on focus enumeration in ShellCore::compute_paint_scene_internal — every painted window now refreshes its focusable contribution, not the primary alone

ShellCore.focusable_tags_per_window per-window map + refresh_window_focusables (record window tags, re-fold) + union_focusable_tags (DEFAULT_WINDOW first, remaining windows by sorted id, de-dup first-occurrence)

refresh_focusable_from_view now routes the programmatic primary re-enumeration through the DEFAULT_WINDOW entry, so a focus request on the primary view no longer clobbers secondary windows' focusable panes
remove_window drops the closed window's focus entry + re-folds the union, so its tags leave the Tab order and the 5.39 stale-focus guard drops focus pointed at the now-unpainted pane

R1069.1.decision_summary: R1069.1 §5.39 §5.16 PR-26 audit-clearance: 3 read-only adversarial reviewers (craft/honesty, SSOT/reactive, north-star/structure) + author re-verification cleared R1069. Verdict: mechanism and structure sound — the hybrid (harvest painted windows / derive declared-but-unpainted from the pure view_for_window) is R1020-faithful (uniform derivation would regress against scene-derived-from-the-PAINTED-scene); reactive subscription is benign (get subscribes but never dirties); SSOT clean (one windows_signal, two readers via Owner::cache identity); all edge cases correct (remove_window/dock-back, painted-but-undeclared, modal containment, R1006 pure mirror). One real doc-honesty regression FIXED: window_focusables claimed harvest and derivation universally agree, but a viewport-gated focusable SET diverges until first paint (the derivation reads use_pane_viewport_size's (0,0) sentinel) — zero behavioural impact (no current consumer gates focusables on the viewport). No logic change.
changes_bullets: window_focusables doc: scoped the "harvest == derivation" claim to non-viewport-gated focusable SETS — a view gating focusable rows on use_pane_viewport_size derives its (0,0) unmeasured projection until first paint, then the harvest corrects it (gap-transient; the dock/undock pane is a static top-level focusable, not viewport-gated, so no current consumer is affected)

Restated the §6.3 no-bare-Effect precondition (the derivation runs view_for_window every gap frame — more exposure than the boot-seed the caveat was written for) and noted the derivation runs ONLY for declared-but-unpainted windows (a painted window short-circuits to the cache = no extra view run at steady state)

declared_window_ids doc: named the Owner::cache signal-identity contract its correctness rests on (resolves the SAME pointer-equal Rc the AppShell reconcile acts on); noted Signal::get subscribes root_owner but is idempotent and read-only (never dirties), so it adds no paint

remove_window doc: the §5.39 stale-focus drop is observable only because reconcile removes the spec from windows_signal BEFORE remove_window (the closed window is then un-declared); a still-declared remove would re-derive and keep the tags (no such caller exists)
verification_bullets: pinion-shell 76/0 lib: +1 modal-guard test (a derived torn tag is NOT focusable while a modal trap is up — focus_set resolves against modal members, the derived tag is not one) + renamed/strengthened the dedup test to exercise the derive->harvest transition (torn tag present exactly once both BEFORE and AFTER its window paints)
Logic byte-identical (doc + test only); clippy --workspace --all-targets --features pinion-runtime/vello = 0 warn; rustfmt clean; mnemosyne validate-workspace T1=0

Reviewer findings re-verified against code: Signal::get subscribes but never dirties (signal.rs) + subscription dedups + Weak cleanup = benign, same class as refresh_focusable_from_view; collect_focusable_tags reads only tag + LayoutStyle::focusable (scene.rs) so a non-gated derivation equals the harvest; windows_signal Owner::cache identity holds (lib.rs ptr_eq test); R1006 pure mirror never reaches the enumeration

Accepted tradeoffs RECORDED not fixed: the per-paint union re-fold is free at steady state (declared-unpainted set empty -> cache short-circuit); a reactive Computed is the eventual end-state but has no 4th-consumer pressure (YAGNI); the unit tests are seam-level because the real drain_focus_request + reconcile_windows path lives behind winit in app.rs
carry_forward_bullets: Phase-D scaling ceiling (document-as-debt, NOT now): union_focusable_tags is recomputed imperatively per paint and re-derives declared-but-unpainted windows; if dozens of dockable panels churn tear-off frequently, lift to a reactive Computed over (painted-cache union declared-signal). Free at rest today (no declared-unpainted -> cache short-circuit); revisit on measured pressure

End-to-end undock-follow (real drain_focus_request + reconcile_windows + winit) is verified live on the sprag side; the pinion unit tests pin the enabling property (declared window contributes derived tags / survives the primary-repaint gap / modal containment)

R1070.decision_summary: R1070 §5.37.13 opt-in Scene::Text MEASURE arm — close the R1068 paint-only gap. An ungated layout::TextMeasure trait lets the vello-gated SelfHostedTextEngine size an eligible single-style Scene::Text leaf by the §5.37 engine (advance + (ascender-descender+line_gap)*px/upem line box), so the measured box registers exactly with the §5.37 paint arm (paint never declines: advance <= rect.w). compute_layout_with_text_measure(.., Option<&dyn TextMeasure>) is the seam; eligibility is the shared SSOT self_hosted_text_eligible (paint+measure: one predicate); the soft-wrap decline mirrors the paint arm (advance > max_width -> None -> parley wraps). text_measure=None is byte-identical to the pre-R1070 parley measure (0 regression). Decoupled across the feature gate — ungated layout never names the vello engine type (the R1067 enumerate-perp-parse layering). Measure-only: paint not yet wired to this box width; shell env opt-in (PINION_TEXT_ENGINE) = R1071.
changes_bullets: layout::TextMeasure trait (ungated seam) + compute_layout_with_text_measure(.., Option<&dyn TextMeasure>) returning the scroll-dirty bit; threaded through compute_layout_inner + lay_out_scroll_contents so scrolled text is sized too

measure closure: a supplied engine override sizes an eligible single-style leaf by §5.37 (advance.ceil width, line-box-height.ceil, line_count=1); the None branch is the unchanged parley measure (text_measure==None is byte-identical to pre-R1070)

text_engine: self_hosted_text_eligible eligibility SSOT (paint+measure share one predicate; paint_adapter::self_hosted_eligible now delegates) + impl TextMeasure for SelfHostedTextEngine using §5.37 advance + vertical metrics

CLEARED the real defects: the §5.37 vertical-metric + soft-wrap math was DUPLICATED across paint and measure (held by prose, not code) -> lifted to shared SSOT helpers LineBoxMetrics + single_line_overflows consumed by both arms; 'full vertical coherence' was untested and overclaimed parley-equality (hhea vs OS/2 typo) -> height now asserted independently + the claim narrowed to coherence with the §5.37 PAINT arm; the soft-wrap decline path was untested -> covered; 'box == advance.ceil' was stated unconditionally (breaks under flex grow) -> qualified to the intrinsic case, with advance<=rect.w named as the universal no-overflow invariant. RECORDED not code-fixed (engine is default-off): the caret divergence (R1068's 'measure=parley -> caret unaffected' is void for eligible editable text), the wire-both-or-neither contract, and the (f32,f32) single-line interim -> binding R1071 constraints. R1071.decision_summary: R1071 §5.39 §5.35 §5.16 PR-27 multi-window key dispatch (sprag dock/undock): a toggle-class shortcut (Ctrl+Shift+Enter) bounced once a second window existed because the shell offered EVERY winit Pressed (OS auto-repeat, plus a stray re-delivery of one press across the undock focus handoff) to the binding with no way to tell them apart, and routed keys globally ignoring which window they arrived at. Fix = two gates + a seam: (1) WidgetCore::apply_key_repeat exposes the platform KeyEvent.repeat flag to the binding (default delegates to apply_key, so 100+ impls byte-unchanged) so a toggle binding swallows auto-repeat; (2) ShellCore tracks the OS-focused window (note_os_focus) and a press acts only on it (is_key_dispatch_window, fail-open) so a stray re-delivery to a now-unfocused window is dropped; (3) ShellCore::key_press_for_window is the per-window key seam (pointer-seam peer) making the double-dispatch headlessly reproducible. a11y/RPC/TUI stay repeat=false; single-window byte-identical.

R1072.decision_summary: R1072 §5.37.14 production shell wiring — the §5.37 self-hosted text engine's first shipping consumer (campaign step 4, resolving the R1070.1 "zero shipping caller" finding). The shell builds one PINION_TEXT_ENGINE-gated SelfHostedTextEngine at ShellCore construction (build_text_engine_from_env, or set_text_engine for a fixture) and threads it into BOTH arms together: paint via to_vello_cached_with_text_engine (the cached production walker, re-adding the variant R1068 dropped) and measure via compute_layout_with_text_measure (compute_paint_scene live + pure mirror + RPC producer; app.rs live + screenshot paint). Default-off (env unset) is byte-identical parley paint+measure, 0 regression. The R1070.1 caret-divergence constraint is resolved by a new TextNode.caret_bearing marker that view_field sets on editable text: it is folded into the shared eligibility SSOT self_hosted_text_eligible so BOTH paint and measure exclude caret-bearing leaves (an editable field's caret/selection/find/bracket/preedit rects all derive from one parley Layout whose advances §5.37 need not match). The marker is also folded into the Scene::Text paint_hash so two leaves differing only in which shaper paints them never share a cached fragment. wire-both-or-neither holds by construction: one engine + one eligibility predicate drive both arms.
