R880.1.decision_summary: Session-review audit remediation (two adversarial reviewers, findings verified by grep+read). Real defects repaid inline: (1) the R781 composite modifier wire was silently broken at nine hand-rolled split_once(':') decoders - a held-modifier release read "PointerUp:c" as the event name, so Ctrl+click activation was dropped on toolbar/menu/context-menu/grid-sort/table/datepicker/file-browser/dock/data-grid; all nine now decode through the split_send_payload SSOT with per-widget regression tests, and the encoder is colocated as compose_send_payload. (2) The chord-to-verb precedence was a 3-copy (virtual_select + node click + marquee) - lifted as SelectionChord over the new Modifiers::command_key (ctrl-or-meta, the R879.1-ratified command predicate; Cmd now works on macOS for select-all/undo/save/zoom/toggle chords). (3) Node editor: a router PointerCancel leaked the marquee band and a stale drag latch (next press teleported the node) - cancel now reverts and resets without journaling; the background-press defensive clear is the full reset; the marquee rect clamps to the world so the painted band and the applied area are one value. (4) Honesty: the r880 demo claimed 30+ asserts but had 24 - raised to 33 (incl. a meta-chord scene) and the R880 store entry corrected via the publishable override ledger.

R881.decision_summary: R881 SS5.35 SS5.49 - middle-button drag-to-pan (Blender/Unreal idiom) + paste-on-release. The shell dropped Middle releases and pasted at press; now the router owns a per-pointer MiddleGesture: press pins pan targets (hovered External tag + deepest ScrollState - gesture capture, no container hopping), the R880 DragLatch (2nd direct capture-path consumer) splits click from pan, and each latched move dispatches the last-minus-current cursor delta (content follows the cursor, grab convention) through the SAME two-stage wheel routing R877 built - stage 1 extracted as offer_wheel_to_external so the wheel path and the pan path cannot diverge. Pan is therefore zero code per binding: plain deltas land on the pinned ScrollState (with a Qt-style sub-pixel remainder carry), and held chords reach the External wheel vocabulary (Ctrl+middle-drag zooms the node canvas via its existing R877 arm - winit itself reports touchpad pans as pixel wheel deltas, so this is one dialect with two producers). Release-in-place resolves to MiddleRelease::Click and only then runs the X11 PRIMARY paste funnel (xterm/Qt release-paste; a pan never pastes); PointerCancel revokes the gesture so a cancelled press neither pastes nor pans (R880.1 mandatory-cancel-arm). Modifiers thread through the new cursor_moved_with_modifiers peer (R781/R877 out-of-band pattern). scene/drag gains a button param (DragButton left|middle wire pair, decode=inverse(encode), unknown names reject) expanding through the identical shell methods the native winit arms call - SS2 #2 peer: an AI client drives drag-to-pan with no new RPC method.

The shell dropped Middle releases and pasted at press; now the router owns a per-pointer MiddleGesture: press pins pan targets (hovered External tag + deepest ScrollState - gesture capture, no container hopping), the R880 DragLatch (2nd direct capture-path consumer) splits click from pan, and each latched move dispatches the last-minus-current cursor delta (content follows the cursor, grab convention) through the SAME two-stage wheel routing R877 built - stage 1 extracted as offer_wheel_to_external so the wheel path and the pan path cannot diverge. Pan is therefore zero code per binding: plain deltas land on the pinned ScrollState (with a Qt-style sub-pixel remainder carry), and held chords reach the External wheel vocabulary (Ctrl+middle-drag zooms the node canvas via its existing R877 arm - winit itself reports touchpad pans as pixel wheel deltas, so this is one dialect with two producers). Release-in-place resolves to MiddleRelease::Click and only then runs the X11 PRIMARY paste funnel (xterm/Qt release-paste; a pan never pastes); PointerCancel revokes the gesture so a cancelled press neither pastes nor pans (R880.1 mandatory-cancel-arm). Modifiers thread through the new cursor_moved_with_modifiers peer (R781/R877 out-of-band pattern). scene/drag gains a button param (DragButton left|middle wire pair, decode=inverse(encode), unknown names reject) expanding through the identical shell methods the native winit arms call - SS2 #2 peer: an AI client drives drag-to-pan with no new RPC method.

R881.1.decision_summary: R881.1 SS5.35 SS5.49 - session-review audit remediation (two adversarial reviewers, findings verified by grep+read; user textbook-quality gate). Real defects repaid inline: (1) the R881 hover-pin invariant was FALSE in the live shell - the per-repaint hover refresh (refresh_hover_for_all_active_pointers) skipped only the capture lock, so a live middle pan (which repaints every move) churned PointerLeave/Enter into whatever slid under the cursor each frame, and DnD had the same pre-existing leak; all three hover-refresh producers now share ONE gesture_pins_hover predicate (capture OR DnD session OR live pan - the R873 one-gate discipline applied to hover), with a mid-pan update_paint_scene regression test that fails the pre-R881.1 router. (2) Cross-button gestures had no exclusivity decision at all: a left press during a live pan routed by a stale hover snapshot (content moving under the cursor) and could open a second concurrent gesture; now the pan owns the pointer (left press AND release swallowed - no orphan PointerUp reaching activation-edge decoders), and a pointer owned by a left gesture refuses middle_down (trailing release = NoPress, so no paste can fire mid-drag); a second middle press can never reset a live pan back into the dead zone (first press wins - an RPC injection racing a native hold cannot demote the user's pan to a paste). (3) The two-stage wheel precedence was a 2-copy whose stage-2 application had ALREADY diverged - the sub-pixel remainder carry existed only on the new pan copy while the original wheel path still stalled forever on the exact slow high-DPI PixelDelta stream the R881 docs cited; dispatch_wheel_two_stage now owns precedence + application math once (callers own only target RESOLUTION - per-event for wheel, pinned for pan, which is data not policy), the wheel side gaining a per-pointer remainder keyed to its scroll target (reset on target change per Qt accumulator discipline, dropped with the cursor). (4) Shift is masked from the pan dialect: Shift+wheel is an axis remap for 1-D notch devices and scrambled the 2-D grab semantics (vertical drag panning horizontally); Shift+MMB is now plain pan, the Blender chord. (5) A cursorless middle press lazy-seeds its origin on the first move instead of resolving Click after arbitrary motion. (6) API symmetry restored to the wheel precedent (plain cursor_moved pair returns the pan flag on every tier; plain CoreShell middle wrappers; TUI back on the plain pair), DragButton wire pair renamed to the as_wire_name/from_wire_name convention, the two docs still describing paste-at-press updated, and the 12-assert overclaim corrected in the second publishable store field the first correction missed.

R896.1.decision_summary: Session-review adversarial audit clearance: 2 subagent reviews + grep/read re-verification surfaced two real defects, both fixed inline. (1) an r837 ZERO-FLAKE race (click gated on scene-tree presence, not rect visibility); (2) an AI-reachable silent v-clip (fixed 268px grid with no vertical scroll dropped grouped overflow rows) fixed with an inner vertical scroll. Scope critique accepted: R896 deferred the higher-value virtualization for the easier h-scroll and over-framed a feature round as architecture.
changes_bullets: r837 ZERO-FLAKE: off-screen-cell click gated on find_by_tag (scene-tree, always present for eager rows) so it never waited for the scroll to settle -> race; re-gated on rect-overlap (_cell_on_screen); scroll-back gate fixed the same way; false "clipped out of the paint scene" comment corrected

editable grid v-clip: a fixed 268px viewport had NO vertical scroll, so grouping a high-cardinality column (Asset, 4 distinct = 8 rows) overflowed the band and clipped the bottom row silently (AI-reachable via set_group) -> added an inner vertical Scene::Scroll (R784 nested single-axis; the header stays outside it so it remains pinned); body still eager (windowed virtualization = R898)
made the grid container cross-axis width contract explicit in prose (the default AlignItems::Stretch that gives the h-scroll its narrower viewport was load-bearing but uncommented)
r896 demo gained an (E) v-scroll witness: group -> 8 rows overflow -> offset_y advances past 0 (bottom rows reachable) -> ungroup -> fits again
verification_bullets: cargo test --workspace green; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --features pinion-runtime/vello clean (-D pedantic)
6 data-grid demos PASS incl r837 (rect-gated) + r896 (h-scroll + new v-scroll witness); hello-data-grid 40 unit green
v-clip fix positively verified: r896 (E) drives set_group "0" -> 4 groups -> data_grid_vscroll offset_y > 0 after scroll-to-bottom, == 0 when ungrouped
carry_forward_bullets: scope self-critique accepted (adversarial reviewer): R896 shipped h-scroll (the easy axis) and deferred virtualization (the real northern-star value) on a flake-risk pretext; the convergence narrative was inflated (the audit itself found "no active smell" to converge)

course-correct: next round is NOT R897 frozen-column; it is VIRTUALIZE the editable grid body (measured-viewport window = the real Model/View-at-scale debt, and the complete v-clip fix) OR diversify to the node-editor substrate (greener per northern-star, escapes the ~10-round single-widget local optimum)

reclaim ~25GB of preinstalled runner SDKs (dotnet/android/ghc/CodeQL/boost) inline before the build in both jobs — inline rm, not an unpinned third-party action (supply-chain surface avoided)
CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 on the test job strips debug line-tables (the bulk of the test-binary link footprint); pass/fail and debug-assertions unchanged

effect is observable only on the next CI run (a green attempt#1 with no manual rerun) — disk reclaim cannot be exercised on the dev box

R903.decision_summary: R903 find & replace (cost-no-object textbook; diversify off the R896-R902 node-editor/tree local optimum, R896 lesson). The find session (needle + case/whole-word flags) lives on TextEditState so the editor is self-describing to AI introspection (find_matches RPC reports count/ranges/current); the current match is the selection (browser/VS Code model), so no fragile current-index state. All-match highlight bands reuse selection_rects_for_range with data = find_matches (windowless-verifiable). Replace All is the FIRST consumer of the undo substrate's reserved macro-transaction axis (begin_macro/end_macro -> MacroCommand): N splices fold into one Ctrl+Z. Find/replace mirrors read<->write on TextFieldExternal. Self-grep lift: the {start,end}|Null encoding is now selection_range_to_value SSOT shared by the selection query + find-next/prev. Single-line editor kept (multiline wraps one Scroll, would break caret-count tests); ASCII case-fold (byte-offset exact); keyboard find-bar UI deferred (RPC is the §2 primary path).

New pinion-core::syntax: SyntaxPalette (fixed classic scheme) + pure highlight_code(text, keywords, palette, font_size) C-family tokenizer (line comment / string-with-escape / number / keyword), char-aware + byte-offset exact. TextEditState::attach_highlighter makes style_runs() a content-derived read (the R903 find_matches derive pattern) so the SINGLE style_runs() read site feeds paint + caret geometry + hit-test + the scene/style_runs RPC — an AI reads the editor's token colouring directly. The attach_highlighter closure IS the language-agnostic seam (no premature Language trait; the keyword slice covers C-family dialects). Runs bake the field font_size (default size 0 = invisible glyphs). Highlighter and manual styling are mutually-exclusive modes (code editor vs rich text); a Highlighter newtype carries a manual Debug so TextEditState keeps its derive. Self-grep: NO lift — is_word_char (find whole-word) and syntax identifier-char are independent concepts coincidentally \w (coupling = wrong-abstraction); attach_* and derived-accessor are idioms, not duplicated logic.

R905.decision_summary: R905 scene-outliner batch operations (cost-no-object textbook; diversify off the R903-R904 text axis back to the editor/DCC axis with a NEW editing capability — the payoff of R902's multi-selection). delete-selected + rename-selected on the stable-id multi-selection, each ONE undo step. delete-selected removes only the TOP-LEVEL selected subtrees (a selected descendant rides along inside its selected ancestor via collect_top_level dedup), captured granularly (parent+index+subtree, not a whole-tree snapshot) so undo restores the exact shape (redo removes by id, undo reinserts ascending-by-index). rename-selected expands a {n} template numbered in pre-order (or a literal). Both are AI-first invoke ops on the multi-select coordinator (delete_selected/rename_selected return the count, undo/redo a bool) — the §2 RPC primary path. Structural mutation is example-local on the concrete OutlinerNode: TreeNode::children_mut returns a slice (can't resize), so a generic tree structural-edit substrate needs a trait extension (children_vec_mut) deferred to a 2nd consumer. Self-grep NO lift: TreeBatchDelete/Rename are peers of file_browser's single-select delete_selected/rename_selected (different cardinality / model / undo) — coupling = wrong-abstraction; the R903 macro axis was NOT forced (a single multi-target command is cleaner for position-coupled deletes than a macro of N, the hello-node-editor shape).

R906.decision_summary: R906 cost-no-object session-review audit clearance (user '교과서적/SSOT/북극성?' on R903-R905). 3-lens adversarial subagents (SSOT/correctness/scope-deferral) + my own grep+read re-verification, bucketed real / over-reach / genuine-defer. REAL fixed: (A) splice_inner SSOT — R903 added the splice primitive but left 3 pre-existing selection branches (insert/backspace/delete-forward) as copies -> routed through splice_inner (4->1, behaviour-identical). (B) dark-mode defect — R904 baked the classic() light palette unconditionally (illegible on a dark surface); added SyntaxPalette::dark()/for_dark + ThemeProvider::is_dark() (the single resolution SSOT theme() now uses) and the example's highlighter picks by theme.is_dark() (captures the provider Rc + calls is_dark() = pure Signal reads -> reactive in the view AND safe from the Owner-less RPC path). (C) insert_subtree silent push-to-root fallback -> debug_assert (R889 silent-corruption-mask). (E) 3-copy band-box emit (find/selection/preedit) -> push_band SSOT (R903 lifted rect_to_band geometry but not the emit). (F) the outliner had NO keyboard editing -> Delete/Backspace=delete_selected, Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y=undo/redo (node-editor precedent; methods existed; was scope-avoidance). (G) begin_macro/end_macro pub but undo/redo unguarded mid-macro -> debug_assert + no-op guard. REJECTED over-reach (verified): is_word_char lift (find search-boundary vs syntax identifier-char = independent concepts coincidentally \w, wrong-abstraction); find_matches.ranges [s,e] vs selection {start,end} (bulk-list pairs vs single W3C range, conventional); replace_all count over-reports no-op replacements (= matches replaced, VS Code convention; a no-op records no undo step, correct). Verdict: cross-round SSOT discipline strong; the gaps were within-round 'added the primitive, did not sweep existing copies' (splice / band) + a dark-mode feature gap + missing editor keys.

R915.decision_summary: Add DragCalibration::traveled_beyond click-vs-drag discriminator; wire into both numeric scrubs so a click focuses the cell and only a past-threshold drag scrubs (completes R914 the canonical DCC way)
changes_bullets: Add DragCalibration::traveled_beyond(basis, threshold_px): the click-vs-drag
discriminator (max cursor travel from press >= threshold), tracked via a new
max_abs_delta on the press anchor (+1 unit test).
Wire it into both numeric scrubs (data-grid + property-grid): is_scrubbing now
means "past the DRAG_CLICK_THRESHOLD_PX dead zone", gating the scrub mutation,
the trailing-click suppression, and the AI `scrubbing` query in one decision.
Result (canonical DCC gesture): a click on a numeric cell now FOCUSES it
(clears the R914 absorption); only a drag past the threshold scrubs.
column-resize + splitter ignore the gate (no click action) — unchanged.

data-grid 44; property-grid 45; the R914 click test renamed + flipped to assert
click-focuses; r875 calibration-frame scrubbing assertion updated).

carry_forward_bullets: The threshold gate is opt-in per consumer: scrubs use it (click vs drag);
column-resize / splitter have no click action so they ignore it. Documented on
DragCalibration::traveled_beyond.
Dead-zone jump: crossing the 4px threshold applies travel from the press, so an
int scrub steps by ~round(4/8)=~0/1 at the boundary (negligible, standard).

deferred (R914 carry; shape/architecture reasons, not effort).

discriminator (max cursor travel from press >= threshold), tracked via a new
max_abs_delta on the press anchor (+1 unit test).
Wire it into both numeric scrubs (data-grid + property-grid): is_scrubbing now
means "past the DRAG_CLICK_THRESHOLD_PX dead zone", gating the scrub mutation,
the trailing-click suppression, and the AI `scrubbing` query in one decision.
Result (canonical DCC gesture): a click on a numeric cell now FOCUSES it
(clears the R914 absorption); only a drag past the threshold scrubs.
column-resize + splitter ignore the gate (no click action) — unchanged.
publishable_verification_bullets: cargo test --workspace -j2: all pass (DragCalibration 5 incl traveled_beyond;
data-grid 44; property-grid 45; the R914 click test renamed + flipped to assert
click-focuses; r875 calibration-frame scrubbing assertion updated).
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --features pinion-runtime/vello: clean.
demos: r915 click-vs-scrub split (34 assert, NEW) + r914 (section H now asserts
click focuses) + r875 (property-grid, unchanged-pass) all PASS (release).
publishable_carry_forward_bullets: The threshold gate is opt-in per consumer: scrubs use it (click vs drag);
column-resize / splitter have no click action so they ignore it. Documented on
DragCalibration::traveled_beyond.
Dead-zone jump: crossing the 4px threshold applies travel from the press, so an
int scrub steps by ~round(4/8)=~0/1 at the boundary (negligible, standard).
scrollbar (SCXML-embedded 1-D) + dock + node (2-D) DragCalibration routing still
deferred (R914 carry; shape/architecture reasons, not effort).

R916.decision_summary: Add node-editor Details panel reflecting the single selected node's properties + selection-relative detail.* RPC (read+intervene alias for node.<selected>.*), the editor select->inspect->edit loop
changes_bullets: Add a Details panel (right sidebar) to hello-node-editor: reflects the single
selected node's editable properties (title / x / y / per-port defaults) as
rows, the Unreal "select -> inspect" surface. Placeholder when not exactly one
node is selected.
Add selection-relative `detail.<field>` RPC: a thin alias for
`node.<selected>.<field>` (read + intervene), delegating through one
`selected_node_path` SSOT so the panel's read and write address the same node;
`Null` / UnknownPath when the selection is not exactly one node (R909 pattern).
`detail.*` editing routes through the identical rename / move / set-default
funnels the absolute `node.<id>` path uses (one mutation path, undoable).
Widen the window to TOTAL_W (palette + canvas + panel) and SSOT it with the
root container's size so the flex row never shrinks (canvas stays at its
PALETTE_W offset — the geometry every demo's coordinates assume).

all PASS (release); geometry probe confirms canvas back at x=132 (unchanged).
in-panel inline click-to-edit deferred (additive GUI affordance, the R909->R910
sequencing) — editing is the AI-first `intervene detail.*` / card path today.

panel reflects + edits via `intervene detail.*` / the node card today; the GUI
click-to-edit affordance is the R910-style follow-up (additive, not a blocker).
detail_row paint is panel-local (the property-grid view_row is example-local,

R917.decision_summary: Session-review audit clearance (R914-R916): declare the complete detail.* schema mirror, make arm_scrub a self-contained fresh start, fix property-grid set_value doc overclaim; all other adversarial findings verified sound or justified-defer
changes_bullets: Session-review adversarial audit (R914-R916) via 3 subagents, every finding
re-verified by hand and bucketed REAL / over-reach / justified-defer.
REAL: node-editor `detail.*` schema under-declared its surface — the generic
delegation answers detail.outputs/input_types/output_types but the schema
listed only 6 of the node.<id>.* fields. Declared the full mirror (AI-first
contract = resolvable surface) + a parity regression test.
REAL: arm_scrub now drops any stale calibration first (self-contained press —
a re-arm never inherits a prior drag's base/cell); both grids + a test.
Doc honesty: property-grid set_value comment no longer implies a shared funnel
(it writes the shared model Signal, not a shared function — unlike data-grid
set_cell); detail.node documented read-only (write via selected/selected_ids).
Verified-sound (no change): DragCalibration routing complete; scrollbar (SCXML)
/ dock+node (2-D) deferrals correct; SCRUB_* 2-copy defer to 3rd consumer;
TOTAL_W SSOT; detail.* recursion bounded 1-deep; detail_row != view_row.
verification_bullets: cargo test --workspace -j2: all pass (2 new R917 regression tests: detail.*
schema-mirror parity, arm_scrub fresh-calibration; node-editor 114, data-grid 45).
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --features pinion-runtime/vello: clean.
demos r916 / r914 / r875 PASS (release) — the schema + arm changes are additive.
audit-clearance round (no new demo); fixes carry regression tests per policy.
carry_forward_bullets: SCRUB_FLOAT_PER_PX / SCRUB_INT_PX_PER_STEP byte-identical across property-grid +
data-grid (2 example sites): the substrate doc reserves the value projection
per-caller (int-steps vs float), and per-widget scrub feel is a design choice
(not divergence-is-a-bug), so per-binding is sound — but a 3rd numeric-scrub
consumer MUST lift a scrub_project() helper to pinion-core, not copy a 3rd time.
r838 demo uses hardcoded canvas pixel coords with no flex-shrink floor; TOTAL_W
documents the window==root coupling. The wire-bezier hit-test is hard to express
path-relatively; pre-existing fragility, acceptable, watched.
R918 = in-panel click-to-edit (R916 follow-up) is the value-first lead but a
real edit-surface redesign (card vs panel field ownership) — fresh budget.

R926.decision_summary: R926 adds matching-bracket support to the text editor as the third derive-on-read consumer (after find_matches R903 / style_runs R904): TextEditState::matching_bracket() re-derives the (open, close) pair the caret sits adjacent to from the live buffer + caret, read by both the paint outline and the scene/<tag>/external/bracket_match RPC slot so they cannot disagree on the pair. R927.decision_summary: Lift ResourceCache keyed-async-carrier substrate (2nd consumer: lazy-list + asset-browser) and add async source-side sort/filter over a virtualized 10k out-of-memory source: sort/filter are query params pushed to the source, the filtered count is a queried Resource, and re-query resets scroll

Two reactive Effects: count loader (filter dep) and page loader (sort/filter/scroll/count deps, gated on count Ready)

R933.1.decision_summary: R933.1 adversarial 3-reviewer session-review of R933 (correctness / SSOT / doc-honesty), every finding re-verified by my own grep+read. One HIGH correctness defect fixed: fold anchors were not shifted on incremental edits, so an edit before a collapsed block could spring it open or, on a coincidental anchor-byte collision, hide the WRONG block (my 'never wrong content' claim was false). Folds now shift/clip at every text-mutation site and across undo/redo replay, the byte-offset peer of the style-run maintenance. Doc-honesty fixes: removed a fabricated fragment-cache claim, reframed the non-editable example as a read-only RPC fold viewer, softened an unverified VS Code citation; fixed an O(N x lines) per-paint re-derivation in the example. Over-reach rejected after re-verification: match_forward granularity (fold walks forward only) and set_text+undo fold non-restore (correct non-journal semantics).

R943.1.decision_summary: R943.1 adversarial session-review clearance (user-requested 'is it textbook / SSOT / north-star?' audit of R942+R943). Found and fixed 2 real Color-popup consistency bugs: the begin verb (keyboard Enter/F2) only opened Choice popups so a Color cell was keyboard-inert (openable by click only); and access_focus_target always emitted the opt (Choice) composite prefix so an open Color popup advertised a dangling aria-activedescendant the swatch grid never paints. Both stem from generalizing the popup machinery for Color everywhere except these two activation/a11y sites. An adversarial grep of every CellKind gate + every CHOICE_OPT_PREFIX use confirmed these were the only two missed; all other Color gates are consistent. R942 (row_cells, LoaderMarker) re-confirmed local-correct.

access_focus_target uses the kind-correct composite prefix (sw for Color, opt for Choice)
both were sites where the popup machinery was generalized for Color everywhere except here
+2 regression tests + 1 demo keyboard-begin assertion

R945.decision_summary: Editor line manipulation: TextEditState::move_lines + duplicate_lines (VS Code Alt+Up/Down move + Shift+Alt copy), N-th consumer of the R938/R939 line-op substrate + a newline-inclusive line_extent_end helper. RPC-primary invoke verbs move-line-up/down + duplicate-line-up/down (keyboard chords deferred — Alt+Arrow overlaps vertical nav). One undo step each; the lone newline relocates exactly when a move crosses the final newline-less line.
changes_bullets: TextEditState gains move_lines(down) + duplicate_lines(down): the move-line (VS Code Alt+Up/Down) and
copy-line (Shift+Alt+Up/Down) commands every code editor has, reusable by every multi-line field
move_lines swaps the current line (or selected block) with the adjacent line as ONE replace_range over
the two-line region, re-sequenced; the lone newline relocates so the buffer keeps exact line structure
even when the move crosses the final, newline-less line (the swapped pair trade which one ends the buffer)
duplicate_lines inserts a copy directly below (one undo step); down chooses caret on the lower copy vs
the upper instance; a last-line block (no trailing newline) gets a separator newline before its copy
caret/selection rides the moved block; a multi-line selection re-covers the moved block
N-th consumer of the R938/R939 line-op substrate (line_starts_in_range) + new line_extent_end helper
(newline-inclusive line end; distinct from syntax.rs line_comment_end which excludes the newline)
line_block_extent lifted as the shared block-finding preamble of move/duplicate (self-grep: byte-
identical 2-consumer mechanical duplicate)
RPC invoke verbs move-line-up/down + duplicate-line-up/down (Null arg -> Bool changed; boundary move
is false; bare field inert) + schema slots; AI-first twins of the chords (RPC-primary, R941 precedent)

no-op, both Case-B newline juggles, multi-line block, one-undo x2, duplicate down/up/last-line; 4 RPC:
verb round-trip, boundary false, duplicate caret-landing, bare-inert + type-mismatch)

R945.1.decision_summary: Adversarial session-review clearance of R944+R945 (parallel deep-audit agents, every finding re-verified by my own grep+read). Cleared 1 HIGH (the inspector's access_focus_target dangled aria-activedescendant for a pointer selection under a since-collapsed ancestor — my 'inspector safe by construction' claim was wrong; fixed by lifting effective_cursor to tree_nav as the genuine 2nd consumer and gating the inspector) + 2 MED (ArrowRight on a loading lazy branch focused the next sibling; move_lines doc over-claimed fold-preservation impossibility). Over-flags rejected by re-reading.
changes_bullets: adversarial session-review of R944+R945 (parallel deep-audit agents; every finding re-verified by my
own grep+read per the verify-claims discipline) — 1 HIGH + 2 MED cleared, over-flags rejected
HIGH (R944): my "inspector safe by construction" claim was WRONG — true only for the keyboard-collapse
path, not the pointer-selection path. The inspector's access_focus_target advertised a dangling
aria-activedescendant when a pointer-selected node's ancestor is later collapsed (the shell sets the
active-descendant CHILD tag unconditionally — tree.rs:284 — guarding only the parent focus tag)
fix: lifted effective_cursor to pinion-core tree_nav (pure fn(rows, cursor)->Option, the genuine 2nd
consumer the HIGH finding revealed) + gated the inspector through it; lazy-tree delegates to the lift
MED (R944): ArrowRight on an expanded-but-still-loading branch focused the next SIBLING (skeleton
filtered from node_rows) — guarded in apply_key_impl (a descent only moves to a deeper row)
MED (R945): move_lines doc over-claimed fold-preservation was impossible — corrected: folds are
non-journal best-effort view-state (R933, set_text clears them) so losing them on a reorder is
consistent, not a regression; manual-run carry is a no-consumer latent gap; LF-internal stance noted
regression tests: tree_nav effective_cursor, lazy-tree loading-branch guard, inspector collapse-gate
verification_bullets: cargo test --workspace -j2 green; 3 new regression tests (effective_cursor gate, ArrowRight-on-loading
stays put, inspector access_focus_target drops to atomic for an off-tree / collapsed-away selection)

agent over-flags rejected by re-reading: char-boundary safety / boundary no-ops / Case-B newline
conservation / undo=one-step / RPC contract parity / keyboard-deferral were all verified genuinely
clean (the R945 single-region-replace move is correct and char-safe across adversarial inputs)
validate-workspace T1 reject=0 / new orphan +0; audit-clearance (demo-exempt; re-ran affected demos)

hello-data-grid::cell_fill and hello-property-grid::row_fill are byte-identical (Surface.lerp(OnSurface,
HOVER) focus fill) = a 2-consumer grid focus-fill duplication; lift to pinion-widget-paint with a proper

navigation movers (set_caret/move_*/select_*) + wholesale set_text clear the mark; edits preserve it

changes_bullets: Add the bounded ("ranged") slider delegate to the property grid: a

changes_bullets: New hello-column-visibility example: data-grid column hide / show, the column
chooser every data grid / asset browser / inspector ships.
Model: a shared Signal<Vec<bool>> (use_visibility), one bit per source column;
the chooser, the view, and the reducer all read it.
Chooser: the R692 ToolbarExternal (primary), one control per column. aria-pressed
AND disabled are both reflective (read from the model each frame): pressed[i] =
visible[i]; the sole remaining visible column's control is disabled (cannot hide
every column) — the 2nd consumer of the R989 reflective toolbar disabled axis.
Grid: the binding projects the visible columns (filtered headers + per-row cells)
into the existing view_table paint; grid_table_nodes announces only the visible
columns (aria-colcount drops as columns hide). No grid-paint change — the
visual<->source column mapping lives in the binding (a 2nd consumer would lift it).
Reducer: a chooser command toggles that column's visibility, gated on the same
reflective col_disabled mask (the sole-visible column cannot be hidden however
the toggle is driven). Keyboard via the shared forward_key_to_field.

disabled control is a no-op when clicked; show a hidden column clears the disabled;
keyboard Home/ArrowRight/Enter toggles; scene/access columnheader + gridcell counts.
example unit tests: disabled-only-sole-visible mask, reducer toggle + last-column
gate, a11y grid columnheader count tracks visibility, toolbar reflective
pressed/disabled.

domain-specific glue (no lift); forward_key_to_field reused (not hand-rolled).

mapping in the example); a 2nd column-visibility consumer triggers lifting a
substrate (a column `order`/visibility analog of the row `order`, or a paint-side
visible_cols param) — abstraction-needs-second-consumer.

-test) is a natural follow-up UI on top of this model.

R990.1.decision_summary: R990.1 adversarial session-review clearance of R989+R990: lift read_roving_focus reader (4-site decode), add selected.<i> write symmetry, correct toolbar disabled doc (aria-disabled vs HTML-disabled), full disabled mask in status
changes_bullets: Adversarial session-review clearance of R989 + R990 (2 independent reviewers +
self-grep). Cleared the real findings; rejected the over-flags with evidence.
HIGH: lift `read_roving_focus(intro) -> (usize, bool)` to widgets/toolbar.rs (the
toolbar peer of read_selected / read_open_state). The (focus, focused) decode was
hand-rolled at 4 sites (hello-toolbar / -selection-toolbar x2 / -column-visibility)
= mechanical 3rd+ consumer the self-grep missed; a slot rename would silently break
all four. All four read_state bodies now call the one reader.
MED: SelRowExternal gains intervene("selected.<i>", bool) — the absolute write
mirror of the selected.<i> read (wire-form read/write symmetry; the ListBoxExternal
multi-select admin path). The send wire was the only mutation = relative-toggle only.
MED: corrected the toolbar disabled module doc — it cited "the APG menu/menubar
convention" but this repo's menu SKIPS disabled (non-activatable); rewrote it to cite
the W3C aria-disabled discipline (author-gates) vs HTML-disabled (UA-suppress at the
widget, what button/menu use), documenting the deliberate divergence + why a derived
(reflective) toolbar disabled cannot own the bit without per-frame cross-external sync.
LOW: hello-selection-toolbar status line emits the full disabled mask
(del/clr/all), matching its "full selection state" doc claim.
Rejected (verified defensible): the emit-then-gate disabled discipline is a valid
W3C aria-disabled pattern (not a hack); #[expect(too_many_arguments)] matches the
sibling menu.rs precedent; SelRowExternal is not a ListBoxExternal reimpl (dynamic
shrinking holder vs fixed-N); the column projection / Vec<bool> / serde bound are
correct 1st-consumer calls.
verification_bullets: workspace test 0 failed; clippy 0 (-D pedantic, --all-targets); validate T1=0.
new unit tests: read_roving_focus decodes both slots (toolbar.rs);
selected.<i> absolute idempotent set + OutOfRange/TypeMismatch errors (sel-toolbar).
r989 demo PASS (now 46 assert: added the selected.<i> absolute-write section —
idempotent set, read mirrors write); r990 demo PASS (35); r692 (hello-toolbar) +
r799 (hello-textarea fmt toolbar) regression demos PASS after the read_roving_focus
refactor + the disabled:false ToolbarControl updates.
self-grep: read_roving_focus now the single decoder for all 4 (focus,focused) sites;
reviewers' over-flags (disabled-discipline hack / arg-bundling / ListBox reimpl)
rejected with code+W3C evidence.
carry_forward_bullets: LESSON: in-round self-grep keeps missing mechanical decoder duplication — the
(focus, focused) decode reached 4 sites before an adversarial review caught it.
Add a "wire-decoder reused at N sites?" axis to the self-grep (read_selected /
read_open_state / read_roving_focus are the lifted family); a slot rename test is
the canary. [[verify-seed-claims-audit-first]] vindicated again: my 'clean' was not.
LESSON: when documenting a new widget's disabled (or any a11y) discipline, grep the
SIBLING widgets' actual behavior before citing them as precedent — button absorbs
(statechart), menu skips, this toolbar aria-disables; they are three valid but
DISTINCT disciplines (owned-suppress vs derived-aria-disabled), and the doc must say
which and why, not hand-wave "the APG convention".
the read_roving_focus reader is generic over any external exposing focus:Int +
focused:Bool (the list external reuses it); a future non-toolbar roving widget gets
it for free.

R998.decision_summary: Model-View at-scale campaign slice 3: a declarative per-row style-rule engine (Wireshark/dlt-class row coloring). A rule is a GridFilter predicate -> a RowTint{bg,fg}; rows paint by the first matching rule (Wireshark precedence). The match half REUSES the R997 GridFilter conjunction, so coloring and filtering share the wire vocab. The rule list lives in a reactive RowStyleState (use_row_style SSOT); RowStyleExternal is the AI-first RPC surface (rule mgmt + per-row match.<row>/tint.<row> introspection without pixels). The paint integrates via an additive VirtualTableData.row_style resolver, resolved per source row (coloring survives re-sort), precedence selection > rule > zebra. New hello-grid-row-style reference example + RPC demo.

use_row_style. The rule predicate IS the R997 GridFilter conjunction, so
coloring and filtering share the wire vocab.
RowStyleExternal: AI-first RPC surface — rule_count / rule.<i> / rules
(query + restore) / add_rule / clear, plus per-row match.<row> / tint.<row>
/ matched_rows via an attached cell source (introspect the coloring without
pixels). Wire: rule "<filter>;<bg-hex>;<fg-hex>", list joined by "|".
pinion-widget-paint table: additive VirtualTableData.row_style resolver
(Option<&dyn Fn(usize)->Option<(Color,Color)>>); row_inputs precedence
selection > rule > zebra; per-SOURCE row so coloring survives a re-sort.
